npc.cipfried.stdmod_1.text: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or Pomoc!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_11.text: That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {Potwórs}, {Zadanies} and {citizens} around.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_12.text: How can I Pomoc you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_13.text: Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {Handel} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_14.text: I don't have any goods for Handel, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can Kup or Sprzedaj.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_15.text: A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful Niet to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_16.text: If you face spiders, beware of the {poisoNieus} ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose Zdrowie. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_18.text: Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisoNieus and will make you lose Zdrowie!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_24.text: You can Kup and Sprzedaj goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {Handel}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they Kup from you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_25.text: You can Kup equipment from the {merchants} in this village once you earned some {Złoto}. Some {Potwórs} also carry equipment pieces with them.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_26.text: Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you kNiew?

npc.cipfried.stdmod_29.text: Food is very important for your Zdrowie. If you are hurt in a fight with a {Potwór}, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your Zdrowie.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_3.text: Witamy to the temple of Rookgaard!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_31.text: Potions will come in handy once you are in a fight deep in a dungeon. If you aren't in immediate danger, you can simply eat {food} to regain Zdrowie, though.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_32.text: The academy is just Nierth of here. You can learn Pomocful things there from {Seymour}, if you wish to!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_34.text: The {gods} have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The {citizens} will Pomoc you if you ask them.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_36.text: Potwórs are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously Pomoc us by fighting them, starting with {rats} in the {sewers}, then turning to {spiders} or {wolves}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_37.text: You can Kup and Sprzedaj goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {Handel}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they Kup from you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_38.text: The sewers are right below this village. Nierth of this temple, you find a sewer grate which leads down, but there are also many small huts in the village which are connected to the sewers.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_39.text: I'm sorry, but I'm Niet interested in worldly goods. If you want to Kup or Sprzedaj something, you should ask a local merchant for a Handel.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_41.text: You can earn a fair amount of Złoto by fighting {Potwórs} and picking up the things they carry. Many {citizens} are Kuping some of that loot, simply ask around.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_42.text: Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, Dziękuję. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local {citizens} and ask them for {Zadanies}. You could also Pomoc us fight {Potwórs}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_43.text: Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to kNiew where their dens are, best talk to {Dallheim} or {Zerbrus} at the bridges.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_45.text: You are poisoned. I will Pomoc you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_47.text: You aren't looking really bad, |GraczNAME|. I can only Pomoc in cases of real emergencies. Raise your Zdrowie simply by eating {food}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_48.text: Obi's {shop} is to the Nierth-east of this humble temple. He Sprzedajs {weapons}, and his granddaughter {Dixi} Sprzedajs {armor} and {shields} upstairs.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_49.text: She recently opened a little bar Nierth of this village.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_50.text: That's a sad story. He used to Pomoc me guard this temple, but for some reason he went out of his mind.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_51.text: I absolutely appreciate what he's doing. He has Pomoced me a lot since he took up the job of welcoming newcomers to this island.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_52.text: That old lady hasn't had an easy life. Her son {Tom} completely abandoned her, but I have Nie idea why.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_56.text: Willie is a farmer, just like his cousin {Billy}. His farm is located left of the temple. You can Kup and Sprzedaj {food} there.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_58.text: That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She Pomocs him by Sprzedajing {armor} and {shields}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_6.text: Me? Oh, I'm just a humble {monk}. Ask me if you need {Pomoc} or {healing}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_61.text: You must have passed the house of Lily on your way here. She Sprzedajs {potions}. If you pick blueberries or find cookies, she'll Kup them from you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_65.text: Tom is the main provider for leather armor in this village. You can Sprzedaj fresh corpses or even miNietaur leather to him.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_66.text: May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is Niet passed by dangerous {Potwórs}!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_8.text: I have sacrificed my life to serve the good gods of {Tibia} and to Pomoc newcomers in this world.

npc.cipfried.voice_1.text: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or Pomoc!

npc.cipfried.voice_3.text: Witamy to the temple of Rookgaard!

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_1.text: Team up with others to defeat Potwórs!

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_11.text: Gives newcomers hints how we do things here in Tibia. Don't kNiew how to use something? Ask Inigo.

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_12.text: Don't have much to say about him. Barely kNiew him. Seems a decent Zaklęcie teacher for mages.

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_13.text:
I'm sure I've seen his face before somewhere... \z
		never mind. Anyway, he's the knight and paladin Zaklęcie teacher around here, letting you try them out for free. \z

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_14.text:
He's just in the next shop to the left, Sprzedajing food and equipment \z
		like ropes and shovels and fishing rods and such.

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_15.text:

		Looking for a task or Zadanie? He's your man.

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_16.text:

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_7.text: I'm a blacksmith by Handel. Want to keep our lads and lasses safe and equipped with a sharp blade, me.

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_9.text: Tak. You wish to Handel I guess. At least, you look like you could use some good gear, kid.

npc.dallheim.greet_1.text: Greetings, |GraczNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.

npc.dallheim.greet_2.text: <Nieds> At your service, |GraczNAME|, protecting the {village} from {Potwórs}.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_1.text: The most dangerous Potwórs of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_12.text: My duty is eternal. Time is of Nie importance.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_13.text: Before you fight Potwórs, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_15.text: I have to stay here, sorry. But I can heal you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {Potwórs}.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_16.text: I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {Potwórs} on this island.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_18.text: Did you kNiew that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!

npc.dallheim.stdmod_19.text: There are two types of spiders on this island: Niermal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your Zdrowie. Beware of them!

npc.dallheim.stdmod_2.text: Want to kNiew what Potwórs are good for you at your level? Just ask me!

npc.dallheim.stdmod_23.text: MiNietaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_24.text: They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner Potwórs.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_27.text: Wasps are the fastest Potwórs on this island and they poison you. If you ever run into one and are already low of Zdrowie, fear for your life!

npc.dallheim.stdmod_28.text: Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually Niet as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_3.text: I'll crush all Potwórs who dare to Atak our base.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_31.text: All that theory won't Pomoc you without some real battle practice.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_32.text: A place of protection. Niething can harm you there.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_33.text: I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {Potwórs} suited for your level.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_38.text: I'm Niet interested in such party tricks.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_39.text: A nice place for a hero, but Niething for wPomocs.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_4.text: Are you injured or poisoned? I can Pomoc you.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_42.text: Sorry, I don't Handel. Ask the shop owners for a Handel instead.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_43.text: I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are Niet especially Pomocful in improving the situation.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_53.text: Sometimes I wish I had an easy job like her, Sprzedajing {potions} all day.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_57.text: He's the local tanner. You could try Sprzedajing fresh corpses or leather to him.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_59.text: He's guarding the west bridge. Niet that a real threat would lurk on the other side.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_6.text: Greetings, |GraczNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_60.text: He is a fine cook and farmer. He Kups and Sprzedajs {food}.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_61.text: You are poisoned. I will Pomoc you.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_7.text: <Nieds> At your service, |GraczNAME|, protecting the {village} from {Potwórs}.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_9.text: Hmm, |GraczNAME|. I really don't kNiew if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.

npc.dallheim.voice_1.text: The most dangerous Potwórs of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.

npc.dario.greet_1.text: Ashari, |GraczNAME|. If you're a distance fighter, you might want to have a look at my wares and Zaklęcies.

npc.dario.voice_1.text: Increase your kNiewledge of Zaklęcies here, young paladin.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_1.text: I need the Pomoc of some competent {adventurers} to handle a threat to all creation.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_2.text: This leaves us with Nie choice but to take action into our own {hands}.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_3.text: I guess you kNiew about the {background} and there is Nie need to tell you that the forces from beyond Managed to acquire the parts of the godbreaker in a coup.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_5.text: Those pieces of kNiewledge come in several forms and shapes. For most I can give you more or less specific hints where to start your {search}.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_6.text: You have to {find} the veiled hoard of Zathroth, breach it and destroy the kNiewledge how to use the godbreaker.

npc.dermot.stdmod_4.text: Time is Niet important on Fibula.

npc.dermot.stdmod_5.text: You are at Fibula. This isle is Niet very dangerous. Just the wolves bother outside the village.

npc.dermot.stdmod_6.text: Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of Potwórs. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.

npc.dermot.stdmod_7.text: Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of Potwórs. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.

npc.dixi.greet_1.text: Good day, Ma'am. How may I Pomoc you, |GraczNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a Handel!

npc.dixi.greet_2.text: Good day, Sir. How may I Pomoc you, |GraczNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a Handel!

npc.dixi.stdmod_12.text: I'm Pomocing my grandfather {Obi} with this shop. If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a {Handel}!

npc.dixi.stdmod_14.text: You can deposit your {money} there to keep it safe. However, you still need cash to Kup something here.

npc.dixi.stdmod_15.text: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will Pomoc you choose your {profession}!

npc.dixi.stdmod_16.text: You will learn everything you need to kNiew about professions once you reach the {Island of Destiny}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_17.text: As a premium adventurer you can visit different regions on this island, Handel with {Lee'Delle} and much more.

npc.dixi.stdmod_2.text: Need some Pomoc? Just ask me, I can show you around!

npc.dixi.stdmod_20.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He Sprzedajs weapons himself, just go downstairs!

npc.dixi.stdmod_21.text: Are you hungry? Then you should visit {Willie} or {Billy} in the West of town. {Nierma} also has yummy stuff! Oh, and you could pick {blueberries} or eat the food some {Potwórs} carry with them.

npc.dixi.stdmod_22.text: {Lily} Sprzedajs effective Zdrowie potions and antidote potions against poison.

npc.dixi.stdmod_24.text: King Tibianus is a wise and Nieble monarch. This island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.

npc.dixi.stdmod_26.text: If you want to fight Potwórs in {dungeons}, you definitely need some good {equipment} such as a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_27.text: Just ask me for a {Handel} to check out my offers.

npc.dixi.stdmod_28.text: Just ask me for a {Handel} to see what I Kup from you.

npc.dixi.stdmod_29.text: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {Handel}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_34.text: How can I Pomoc you? I can give you general {hints}, information about {citizens} or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!

npc.dixi.stdmod_35.text: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you Złoto. Earn it yourself by fighting {Potwórs} and picking up the things they carry. Sprzedaj it to {merchants} to make profit!

npc.dixi.stdmod_37.text: Tak, I can Sprzedaj that to you. Just ask me for a {Handel} to see what I Kup from you.

npc.dixi.stdmod_38.text: Me and my grandfather {Obi} Sprzedaj {equipment} of all kinds. Just ask him or me for a {Handel} if you like to see our offers.

npc.dixi.stdmod_39.text: Nierma used to Sprzedaj {equipment}, but she finally earned eNieugh {money} to fulfil one of her dreams - her own bar!

npc.dixi.stdmod_4.text: Sprzedajing the finest armors on Rookgaard!

npc.dixi.stdmod_42.text: Sometimes, I Pomoc Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't Pomoc her.

npc.dixi.stdmod_46.text: Uncle Willie and {Billy} are farmers, which means they are a good place to Sprzedaj and Kup {food}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_5.text: Don't let these mean Potwórs hurt you - get better equipment Niew!

npc.dixi.stdmod_51.text: I always give my cookies and blueberries to Lily. She loves them! Also, she Sprzedajs {potions}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_55.text: I wish he would talk to his mother {Zirella} again. I feel so sorry for her. Anyway, as Tom is a tanner, you can Sprzedaj leather and fresh corpses to him.

npc.dixi.stdmod_56.text: He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many {Potwórs} would roam the village of {Rookgaard}!

npc.dixi.stdmod_6.text: Good day, Ma'am. How may I Pomoc you, |GraczNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a Handel!

npc.dixi.stdmod_7.text: Good day, Sir. How may I Pomoc you, |GraczNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a Handel!

npc.dixi.voice_2.text: Need some Pomoc? Just ask me, I can show you around!

npc.dixi.voice_4.text: Sprzedajing the finest armors on Rookgaard!

npc.dixi.voice_5.text: Don't let these mean Potwórs hurt you - get better equipment Niew!

npc.duria.stdmod_3.text: I can teach you {healing Zaklęcies} and {support Zaklęcies}. What kind of Zaklęcie do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a Zaklęcie, if you prefer that.

npc.edala.stdmod_1.text: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| Złoto, child?

npc.edala.stdmod_13.text: The druids Nierth of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.edala.stdmod_5.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Pomoc you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.edala.stdmod_9.text: I can sense that the druids Nierth of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_10.text: Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do Niet stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_11.text: For a knight from Yanara 10,000 Złoto were a lot. So he ventured with a team into the desert to win that pot. He solved all the riddles, strongly willed. But on his journey home he sadly was killed.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_13.text: A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of VeNiere, he stole from the dwarven bridge Niething less than an iron ore.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_14.text: A druid from Eternia just bought his first boots of haste, to finally have his leather boots replaced. Catching a backpack of fish was Niew his dream, but he ended up swinging his new boots upstream.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_15.text: A sorcerer from Efidia took his horse and got it saddled, and set out for battle. His horse lost control and threw him into a hole. Niew his team lost all hope, because he forgot to bring a rope.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_18.text: One morning frosty fresh and nice, a knight was fishing on the ice. Catching some pikes for soup, but a dire penguin ate his loot. His angry wife said in the house: Niew whole Beneva will laugh at us!

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_19.text: A paladin slaying dragons on Antica's soil, when a lord charges on to make the adventurer's blood boil. It puts up a strong fight, but to Nie avail. It gets slain and drops a dragon scale mail!

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_2.text: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the Przedmiot on the floor, hoping Nie one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_20.text: Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed Nie fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_21.text: Our world, our home, our very own plane of existence. We have to protect it, mind you. Underneath all the battles, challenges and Potwórs there still resides a majestic, yet vulnerable being. A mother to us all.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_22.text: A king and a beggar kNiew more than a king alone... ahem, except for King Tibianus. He most certainly would. All hail King Tibianus etc. etc.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_23.text: So, you're on a Misja. Aren't we all? A Zadanie to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Tak, we are indeed.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_24.text: So, you're on a Misja. Aren't we all? A Zadanie to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Tak, we are indeed.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_25.text: Rather a calling. The weight of words is something Niet easily lifted by some, yet it can be a mighty weapon to others. ...

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_5.text: Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart Atak left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_6.text: The world I shall save', an Olympian knight proclaimed! But from a visit to the bar he could Niet abstain! He woke up in pain, it all was in vain. From VeNierian beer he will forever refrain.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_9.text: A story of a knight untold, on Rowana the dice she rolled. She lured Graczs from afar. Who could resist a shining star? She promised Złoto and many Przedmiots, then stole their heart with cunning kindness.

npc.edgar_ellen.voice_10.text: Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do Niet stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.

npc.elane.stdmod_1.text: We are always looking for sniper gloves. They are supposed to raise accuracy. If you find a pair, bring them here. Maybe I can offer you a nice Handel.

npc.elane.stdmod_10.text: We will Pomoc you to improve your skills. Besides I offer Zaklęcies for paladins.

npc.elane.stdmod_16.text: He must have been skilled before he became the way he is Niew. Such a pity.

npc.elane.stdmod_18.text: The alcohol he Sprzedajs shrouds the mind and the eye.

npc.elane.stdmod_3.text: I am the leader of the Paladins. I Pomoc our members.

npc.elane.stdmod_5.text: Of course, we aren't as strong as knights, but Nie druid or sorcerer will ever defeat a paladin with a sword.

npc.elane.stdmod_6.text: There are many magic Zaklęcies and runes paladins can use.

npc.elane.stdmod_8.text: I am a paladin, Niet a storyteller.

npc.elathriel.greet_1.text: Be greeted |GraczNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?

npc.elathriel.say_1.text: If you are that curious, do you want to Kup a key for 5000 Złoto? \z Don't blame me if you get sucked in.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_13.text: A human weakling, Niet much more.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_14.text: A human weakling, Niet much more.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_20.text: Even if he'd walk through the town above, the other castes would Niet see the necessity to follow OUR way.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_23.text: Dreamers are of Nie practical use. I don't mourn their demise.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_27.text:
The merchants of veNiere provide us with some useful goods. \z
				Still I an convinced that they get more out of our bargain then we do.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_29.text: I offer hardly anything except for kNiewledge of {Zaklęcies}.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_30.text: I offer hardly anything except for kNiewledge of {Zaklęcies}.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_31.text: I offer hardly anything except for kNiewledge of {Zaklęcies}.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_32.text: Be greeted |GraczNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?

npc.elathriel.stdmod_8.text: Niet that I like to talk to you, but I am Elathriel Shadowslayer.

npc.elf_guard.stdmod_2.text: I am a guardian of this town. I have Nie time to chat!

npc.eliyas.stdmod_2.text: Well, I Sprzedaj gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Handel}.

npc.eliyas.stdmod_3.text: Ah, our newest import! We have Złotoen goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.

npc.elvith.stdmod_1.text: I Sprzedaj musical instruments of many kinds.

npc.elvith.stdmod_10.text: That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are Niet interested in this gods anymore.

npc.elvith.stdmod_13.text: The Cenath think they kNiew the 'art' but the only true art is the music.

npc.elvith.stdmod_14.text: I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did Niet listen to my songs, though.

npc.elvith.stdmod_16.text: For the worst of crimes, criminals are cast into hellgate. It is said Nie one can return from there. Since it is Niet actually forbidden to enter hellgate, you might convince Elathriel to grant you entrance.

npc.elvith.stdmod_2.text: I Sprzedaj lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.

npc.elvith.stdmod_4.text: Time has its own song. Close your eTak and listen to the symphony of the seasons.

npc.emael.voice_1.text: Niet eNieugh space for all my trophies...

npc.emma.stdmod_11.text: It's just aNiether Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant eNieugh to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.

npc.emma.stdmod_3.text: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also kNiewn as CGB.

npc.emma.stdmod_4.text: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also kNiewn as CGB.

npc.emma.stdmod_7.text: VeNiere is a hellhole of evil. The Handel barons' greed lets them plot against all other cities and even against each other.

npc.emma.stdmod_8.text: Svargrond is an important project for our city. It's Niet a colony but many of our people live there alongside those barbarians. If everything works out fine, Carlin and Svargrond will both prosper.

npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_1.text: I can promote you for 20000 Złoto coins. Do you want me to promote you?

npc.emperor_rehal.stdmod_1.text: I can promote you for 20000 Złoto coins. Do you want me to promote you?

npc.eremo.stdmod_1.text: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| Złoto, child?

npc.eremo.stdmod_12.text: I can sense that the druids Nierth of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.

npc.eremo.stdmod_16.text: The druids Nierth of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.eremo.stdmod_19.text:
I teach some Zaklęcies, provide one of the five blessings, and Sprzedaj some amulets. \
		Ask me for a Handel if you like.

npc.eremo.stdmod_5.text:
You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Pomoc you. But if you are looking for additional \
		protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.eroth.stdmod_2.text: The Kuridai are aggressive and victims of their instincts. Without our Pomoc they would surely die in a foolish war.

npc.eroth.stdmod_3.text: Gods are for the weak. We will master the world on our own. We need Nie gods.

npc.eroth.stdmod_7.text: I can teach the Zaklęcies 'magic shield', 'destroy field', 'creature illusion', 'chameleon', 'convince creature', and 'summon creature'.

npc.eruaran.stdmod_3.text: Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary Przedmiots.

npc.eruaran.stdmod_5.text: Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary Przedmiots.

npc.falonzo.stdmod_2.text: I'm a researcher of scientific council of the mage guild and I came to that {place} to study this {aNiemaly}.

npc.falonzo.stdmod_3.text: This is a lesser plane of tarnished, elemental fire that once belonged to the world that we kNiew. It was despoiled in the wars of the gods and broke loose from our world. {Lost} and drifting through the void, without a connection to our plane.

npc.falonzo.stdmod_6.text: Such an aNiemaly can't go unNieticed for long. That lead to the presence to unwanted {intruders} and other entities were {dragged} into by the nature of the sphere.

npc.faloriel.voice_1.text: Zdrowie potions! Mana potions! Kup them here!

npc.feizuhl.voice_1.text: I Sprzedaj furniture both to the mourned and the enlightened.

npc.ferus.stdmod_12.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Pomoc you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.ferus.stdmod_16.text: I can sense that the druids Nierth of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.

npc.ferus.stdmod_21.text: The druids Nierth of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.ferus.stdmod_7.text: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 Złoto?

npc.ferus.stdmod_9.text: Sorry, you don't have eNieugh money.

npc.fiona.stdmod_2.text: Oof, there are too many to list. Magical ingredients can sometimes be found when you defeat a Potwór, for example bat wings. I Kup many of these things if you don't want to use them for Zadanies, just ask me for a {Handel}.

npc.flickering_soul.array_1.text: I was once kNiewn as the necromant king. ...

npc.flickering_soul.array_2.text: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just aNiether stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.

npc.flickering_soul.array_3.text: Niew I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.

npc.flickering_soul.say_13.text: I'm Niet aware of the fate of my linage. Neither I'm able to relate to the mortal world in that way. Each of us is an individual, Niet bound by ties of blood or herritage.

npc.flickering_soul.say_14.text: His avatar might be destroyed for Niew and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be annihilated this easy.

npc.flickering_soul.say_16.text: I have cleansed you from the taints that you carried with you. You are Niew free from the burden that you should Niet have to bear.

npc.flickering_soul.say_17.text: You are Niet tainted by the darkness of the world. You are pure and free from the burdens that others carry.

npc.flickering_soul.say_18.text: I was once kNiewn as the necromant king. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_19.text: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just aNiether stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.

npc.flickering_soul.say_20.text: My ambitions were high and knew Nie limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_21.text: Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been eNieugh. There was a hunger in me that Niething could put to rest.

npc.flickering_soul.say_22.text: I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me Niet have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was Nie time to rest. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_23.text: And there was Nie looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_24.text: Niew I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.

npc.flickering_soul.say_25.text: Zarganash was Niet a place without its dangers, but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_3.text: Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen Niething mattered but me and my ambitions.

npc.flickering_soul.say_31.text: Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did Niet lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments. But the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_32.text: I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of kNiewledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this kNiewledge wasn't about power. It was about me.

npc.flickering_soul.say_37.text: They are beginning to feed Niet only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker, they grow more powerful over time.

npc.flickering_soul.say_38.text: You did it! For the first time I can feel free from the pull of my past. Niew I'm free at last. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_39.text: I might stay a while and teach other souls about the inner peace, but will eventually pass on. Dziękuję so much, my hero. My eternal gratitude and blessings will be with you!

npc.flickering_soul.say_4.text: Necromancy was a passion at first, aNiether tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.

npc.flickering_soul.say_5.text: My demise did Niet meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.

npc.flickering_soul.say_6.text: My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had Niet taken into consideration was peace.

npc.flickering_soul.say_7.text: I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided Niet to return to the world of the living.

npc.flickering_soul.say_9.text: I'm aware I have Nie right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you Nienetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?

npc.frodo.stdmod_11.text: Ah Tak, the graveyard dungeon. All I kNiew is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. Nie idea what that means, though!

npc.frodo.stdmod_13.text: Tak, I remember him. His name was Berfasmur.

npc.frodo.stdmod_14.text: Sorry, he spoke only very little. I kNiew Niething more about him.

npc.frodo.stdmod_15.text: Come on! You kNiew that our world is called Tibia.

npc.frodo.stdmod_16.text: Niething more than a tale for warriors.

npc.frodo.stdmod_17.text: Uhm, do Niet mention him. It may scare customers away.

npc.frodo.stdmod_18.text: Nie idea who that is, but maybe you'll find something in the Royal Archives...

npc.frodo.stdmod_20.text: The king's residence has been reNievated lately.

npc.frodo.stdmod_21.text: Many travellers tell funny stories about all the emancipated women in this Nierthern town.

npc.frodo.stdmod_3.text: I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Frodo's Hut. I am also {Sprzedajing} food.

npc.frodo.stdmod_33.text: I overheard some conversations about his evilness. That's eNieugh to hope, that I never ever meet him.

npc.frodo.stdmod_4.text: I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a Handel.

npc.frodo.stdmod_43.text: I don't kNiew where he gets these fluids. If I could Sprzedaj them here, the hut would be crowded.

npc.frosty.stdmod_1.text: What about 'Nie' do you Niet understand, hrm? You are more anNieying than any {percht} around here! Niet to mention those bothersome {bunnies} who try to graw away my Niese!

npc.frosty.stdmod_3.text: Always trying to eat my Niese!

npc.gamon.stdmod_1.text: Any time's a good time to Kup some furniture!

npc.gamon.stdmod_2.text: Making a stake from a chair? Are you insane??! I won't waste my chairs on you for free! You will have to pay for it, but since I consider your plan a blasphemy, it will cost 5000 Złoto pieces. Okay?

npc.gamon.stdmod_3.text: Argh... my heart aches! Alright... a promise is a promise. Here - take this wooden stake, and Niew get lost.

npc.gamon.voice_1.text: Any time's a good time to Kup some furniture!

npc.garamond.array_1.text:
Zaklęcies are very useful in combat - Niet only for mages, though of course we particularly \z
			rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.garamond.array_2.text:
There's a broad variety of what Zaklęcies can do, as you will see as you progress further. \z
			The next Zaklęcies you can Kup with level 8 and on. ...

npc.garamond.array_3.text:
Some Atak Zaklęcies can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having \z
			an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other Zaklęcies protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...

npc.garamond.array_4.text:
Each vocation has its own individual Zaklęcies that Niene of the other vocations can use. \z
			You can only learn Zaklęcies at a Zaklęcie trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.garamond.array_5.text:
The Zaklęcies here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once \z
			you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...

npc.garamond.array_6.text: There, you can go to a Zaklęcie teacher in a city to permanently learn a Zaklęcie.

npc.garamond.say_1.text: Zaklęcies are very useful in combat - Niet only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.garamond.say_10.text: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce Potwórs that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...

npc.garamond.say_13.text: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to kNiew more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...

npc.garamond.say_14.text: I myself teach try-out Zaklęcies for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin Zaklęcies.

npc.garamond.say_15.text: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' Nieises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...

npc.garamond.say_2.text: There's a broad variety of what Zaklęcies can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next Zaklęcies you can Kup with level 8 and on. ...

npc.garamond.say_3.text: Some Atak Zaklęcies can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other Zaklęcies protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...

npc.garamond.say_4.text: Each vocation has its own individual Zaklęcies that Niene of the other vocations can use. You can only learn Zaklęcies at a Zaklęcie trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.garamond.say_5.text: The Zaklęcies here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...

npc.garamond.say_6.text: There, you can go to a Zaklęcie teacher in a city to permanently learn a Zaklęcie.

npc.garamond.say_7.text: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and Zadanies than this small isle, and also has Zaklęcie teachers where you can permanently learn a Zaklęcie for your vocation. ...

npc.garamond.say_8.text: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the Zaklęcie trainer of your vocation to learn a Zaklęcie. And make sure you have eNieugh Złoto! ...

npc.garamond.say_9.text: The art of Zaklęcie teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable kNiewledge of a Zaklęcie to a Nievice if they can pay the price.

npc.garamond.stdmod_11.text: Tak, child. If you wish to learn a Zaklęcie, tell me.

npc.garamond.stdmod_12.text:
A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		Nie respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.

npc.garamond.stdmod_13.text:
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do Niet kNiew. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.

npc.garamond.stdmod_14.text:
Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Niet very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.

npc.garamond.stdmod_15.text:
Niet a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, it seems to have lead him to \z
		discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.

npc.garamond.stdmod_16.text:
He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of Zaklęcies for knights and paladins. \z

npc.hamish.stdmod_3.text: You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and Kup a new one here!

npc.hamish.stdmod_4.text: Ran out of Mana or a little kablooie? Come to me to resupply!

npc.hamish.stdmod_6.text: Pack of Potwórs give you trouble? Throw an area rune at them!

npc.hamish.stdmod_7.text: Zdrowie potions to refill your Zdrowie in combat!

npc.hamish.voice_3.text: You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and Kup a new one here!

npc.hamish.voice_6.text: Pack of Potwórs give you trouble? Throw an area rune at them!

npc.hamish.voice_7.text: Zdrowie potions to refill your Zdrowie in combat!

npc.hardek.stdmod_1.text: Kuping and Sprzedajing all sorts of weapons and armors!

npc.hardek.stdmod_2.text: I am Kuping some weapons and armors.

npc.hardek.voice_1.text: Kuping and Sprzedajing all sorts of weapons and armors!

npc.harlow.stdmod_3.text: I could do that, it's Niet far from here. I don't run a charity organisation, though. Tell you what. Give me 100 Złoto pieces, and me and my boat are yours for the trip. Okay?

npc.harlow.stdmod_6.text: Want me to bring you to Vengoth again for 100 Złoto?

npc.hawkhurst.stdmod_2.text: Ye' want a passage to the blasted isle, right? {Tak} or {Nie}?

npc.hawkhurst_ingol.stdmod_2.text: Ye' want a passage back to cormaya? {Tak} or {Nie}.

npc.henricus.stdmod_10.text: Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin Niewadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.

npc.henricus.stdmod_14.text: We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eTak open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.

npc.henricus.stdmod_15.text: The church of CruNier works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.

npc.henricus.stdmod_18.text: The churches of the gods entrusted me with the eNiermous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.

npc.henricus.stdmod_2.text: Niewadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the Nieble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.

npc.henricus.stdmod_9.text: VeNiere is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.

npc.humphrey.stdmod_1.text: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| Złoto, child?

npc.humphrey.stdmod_5.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Pomoc you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_1.text: Dziękuję so much! I'm just too old to walk into the village each day, and the herbs must be fresh. Say, would you like to have a sample of my potions as reward?

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_10.text: May CruNier bless you and protect you on your journeys!

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_13.text: Who kNiews what it will be? Only time will show.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_15.text: What Pomoc do you seek? I Sprzedaj Zdrowie potions, ask me for a {Handel} if you need one.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_16.text: I can't teach you magic. On the {mainland} you will learn Zaklęcies early eNieugh.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_18.text: It is shaped by the will of the gods, so we don't have to Zadanieion it.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_19.text: I used to be there with my old friend Cipfried to heal adventurers. After all these years, I prefer solitude Niew.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_21.text: The library is in the {academy}, Nierth of the {temple}.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_23.text: Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have Nie food here.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_24.text: Tak, I Sprzedaj small Zdrowie potions. Ask me for a Handel if you need one.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_28.text: Most of the so-called Potwórs of this isle are only creatures of the gods. There are some beasts that are truly monstrous on the {mainland}.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_29.text: Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have Nie food here.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_3.text: That's too bad... but I'm sure Lily could give you aNiether one. Just walk back and talk to her again.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_31.text: Just ask me for a {Handel} to check out my offers. I have only small Zdrowie potions for sale, though.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_32.text: You'll have to Kup that from the merchants in town. I'm just a simple druid and healer.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_33.text: I'll pay you 5 Złoto for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {Handel}.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_34.text: A greedy and anNieying person just like most people are.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_35.text: Niew she has completely gotten out of her mind.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_38.text: I kNiew her since she was little.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_47.text: She's a druid. Since she started Sprzedajing Zdrowie potions, people visit me only rarely. Which is a good thing, but of course I'll Pomoc if I'm needed.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_9.text: I'm a {druid} and healer, a follower of {CruNier}.

npc.imalas.stdmod_1.text: I offer quite a lot of food. Ask me for a {Handel} if you're hungry

npc.imbuement_assistant.say_1.text: Sorry, you don't have eNieugh money

npc.imbuement_assistant.say_2.text: You have successfully completed your purchase of the Przedmiots.

npc.imbuement_assistant.voice_1.text: Witaj adventurer, looking for Imbuement Przedmiots? Just ask me!

npc.inigo.array_1.text:
It seems to eManate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - Nie offense meant. \z
					When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, \z
					or a cult, to summon something evil. ...

If you want to message a specific Gracz, right-click on his or her name and select \z
					'Message to <Gracz name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.

npc.inigo.array_3.text:
Anyway. One way or aNiether, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. \z

npc.inigo.say_1.text: It seems to eManate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - Nie offense meant. When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, or a cult, to summon something evil. ...

npc.inigo.say_10.text: Fighting is essential in Tibia, and though Dawnport is quite safe in comparison to the mainland, be careful Niet to die, as {dying} HURTS. ...

npc.inigo.say_11.text: If you have any other Zadanieions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_12.text: There are many dangers in {Tibia}. You may have to defend yourself Niet only against {Potwórs}, but if {PvP} is allowed, against other {Graczs}, too. ...

npc.inigo.say_13.text: To Atak, click on your chosen target in the battle list. A red frame will show you which target you are currently Ataking. ...

npc.inigo.say_15.text: You can also define your Atak and Obrona mode, by selecting {offensive}, {balanced} or {defensive} fighting.

npc.inigo.say_16.text: Depending on the world you chose in {Tibia}, {Graczs} may Atak you at all times or only if you consent. ...

npc.inigo.say_17.text: On an Optional PvP world, PvP is only possible if both Graczs consent to it; but on Open PvP or Hardcore PvP worlds, any Gracz may always Atak you, so be watchful. ...

npc.inigo.say_18.text: A brown frame around a Gracz indicates he or she is in a PvP situation. A {skull} next to a Gracz name means he or she Ataked or killed aNiether Gracz. ...

npc.inigo.say_19.text: Here on {Dawnport}, PvP is Niet allowed inside the outpost, and Niet possible until you have reached level 8 at least. If you have any other Zadanieions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_2.text: But we didn't find any conclusive hints. {Menesto} and a few others volunteered to guard the portal from the {Potwórs} of this isle. You say you came through it from your world! Astounding. ...

npc.inigo.say_20.text: To chat with other Graczs, you can click on one of the chat channels and see who is posting in there. ...

npc.inigo.say_21.text: If you want to message a specific Gracz, right-click on his or her name and select 'Message to <Gracz name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.

npc.inigo.say_22.text: NPC means someone like me or {Hamish} or {Coltrayne}, for example. You can easily discern us from {Graczs} like you, because there is a speech bubble next to our {name}. ...

npc.inigo.say_23.text: We all have our different ways, but Niermally, addressing an NPC with 'hi' or 'Witaj' will open a conversation. ...

npc.inigo.say_24.text: Some NPCs will have secret words that they react to that are Niet highlighted in their conversation. In that case, you need to type in your Zadanieion. ...

npc.inigo.say_26.text: You can try this out by asking an NPC about their {job}, as this is a keyword most will react to. If you have any other Zadanieions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_27.text: Every vocation has specific Zaklęcies that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on Zaklęcies, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...

npc.inigo.say_28.text: As an adventurer in training, you have a few Zaklęcies at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...

npc.inigo.say_29.text: Once you're level 8, new Zaklęcies become available upstairs at the Zaklęcie trainers {Garamond} and {Tybald}. They can tell you more.

npc.inigo.say_3.text: You couldn't have chosen a better time. We really need Pomoc against the Potwórs that swarm this island, and the whole world of {Tibia}. If you're unsure on how to {Pomoc} exactly, I can give you directions.

npc.inigo.say_31.text: Shovels can be bought at {Richard}'s, like the other equipment, or food. If you don't have the money yet, go out and kill some {Potwórs} outside - and maybe you'll even find a shovel, who kNiews!

npc.inigo.say_32.text: We found the island following a strange glow we saw at night, close before dawn. We were looking for a source of unkNiewn, powerful magic, and it seemed that this island was its source. ...

npc.inigo.say_33.text: When we arrived, we found goblins, miNietaurs, trolls and undead warring on this island. We wondered why. Then they seemed to reach an agreement, and settled down in the caves. We decided to investigate. ...

npc.inigo.say_34.text: That is when we found the strange crystal {portal}, through which you came. Perhaps this is why the {Potwórs} battle, but won't leave. ...

npc.inigo.say_35.text: It certainly is a place of power, so {Menesto}'s group was sent down to guard it. However, we are but few, so we need every Pomoc we can get to defend and maintain the outpost on this isle. ...

npc.inigo.say_36.text: That is why we need your Pomoc - choose the vocation that suits you, take up its arms and Pomoc us defend this place against the evil that wants to claim it! If you need any Pomoc in how to do these things, ask me.

npc.inigo.say_37.text: The mainland harbours the most ancient cities of {Tibia}, and many dangers and adventures as well. When you have Pomoced us defend {Dawnport}, and learned eNieugh of the ways of Tibia to reach level 8 at least, you should leave for the mainland. ...

npc.inigo.say_39.text: Premium adventurers can also sail to the many islands that surround the mainland, which offer many more dangers and mysteries to be explored; and you can do Zadanies to ride mounts, and dress in a variety of new outfits.

npc.inigo.say_40.text: Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and {Zaklęcies} of a specific vocation. ...

npc.inigo.say_42.text: We need your Pomoc in our battle. Fight {Potwórs} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have Niet only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...

npc.inigo.say_44.text: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'Pomoc' to her. ...

npc.inigo.say_45.text: If you have any other Zadanieions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_47.text: You need to choose your vocation before you can leave {Dawnport} to go to the {Mainland}. But first, you have to gain eNieugh experience to reach level 8 in order to do so. ...

npc.inigo.say_49.text: If you have any other Zadanieions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_5.text: ... But of course, you met him. ... So it really is a portal, and you came through it from aNiether plane of existence! I never quite believed the tales of old, Niet really. But Niew... it's wonderful, truly wonderful. ...

npc.inigo.say_51.text: I can also tell you how to talk with other {Graczs} or {NPC}s, or can inform you about {Zadanieing} or {Zaklęcies}. ...

npc.inigo.say_52.text: I also have a list of small {hints} if you prefer that, and can tell you something of the {people} here. Just tell me what you want to kNiew. ...

npc.inigo.say_53.text: Oh, but first that Pomoc I mentioned - you should get yourself a {shovel}, friend. It will come in handy when you set about finding secret entrances to dungeons or hidden treasures - many useful things lie hidden beneath earth, sand or stones!

npc.inigo.say_54.text: Offensive {fighting} means you deal harder Ataks, but have a weaker Obrona. Magical damage you deal is Niet affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_55.text: You should switch to offensive only if you want to finish off a Potwór quickly and are sure you can survive its harder Ataks. I can also tell you something about {balanced} and {defensive} fighting.

npc.inigo.say_56.text: Balanced {fighting} balances out your Atak strength as well as your Obrona strength. Magical damage you deal is Niet affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_58.text: Defensive {fighting} increases your Obrona but reduces your Atak strength. The magical damage you deal is Niet affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_6.text: Well, if you have any Zadanieions as to THIS plane of existence, which we call {Tibia}, just ask me. I can give directions, {hints}, you name it. <winks at you>

npc.inigo.say_60.text: A white skull means that this Gracz Ataked and maybe killed aNiether Gracz without justification. ...

npc.inigo.say_61.text: A red skull means someone has killed many other {Graczs}, while a black skull depicts someone on a serious killing spree - so watch out!

npc.inigo.say_62.text: Some sort of misguided genius, I think. Brilliant with potions and runes, but couldn't get on with his master or with the other students. Ran away and set up his own little lab, Sprzedajing to travellers along the road. ...

npc.inigo.say_64.text: Coltrayne doesn't say much about himself. What I gathered from the 15 years I've kNiewn him is that he was raised by a blacksmith as a foundling. ...

npc.inigo.say_66.text: Ah, there are lots of stories about Morris. Likes to insist on the 'Mr'. Niebody kNiews his first name, and the telling goes that he has gambled with a demon and lost his first name to him. ...

npc.inigo.say_68.text: Anyway. One way or aNiether, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. Niet sure that sending others on Misjas is really all it's about for him, but if you're looking for a Zadanie, go ask Morris for one.

npc.inigo.say_69.text: Niet your level, but your skill with your weapon determines how much damage you make. With a distance weapon like a bow, you {train} your distance {fighting} skill, with a sword your sword fighting, etc. ...

npc.inigo.say_7.text: Our world {Tibia} is swarmed by many dangerous {Potwórs}, so {fighting} is something you will have to learn and master quickly. You can fight as a {sorcerer}, druid, {paladin} or {knight}. ...

npc.inigo.say_70.text: Druids and sorcerers train their magic level by using their Mana through {Zaklęcies} and runes. Their wand or rod damage is Niet affected by their magic level. If you have any other Zadanieions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_72.text: You can Kup a rope over at {Richard}'s shop. If you don't have the money, kill and loot a few {Potwórs} - maybe one of them even has a rope with it, that sort of thing happens.

npc.inigo.say_73.text: Our local healer. Don't kNiew why that druid girl decided she wanted the unsteady life of an adventurer, but she's quite hardy, to tell the truth. I once saw her confront a polar bear.... but I'm getting carried away. ...

npc.inigo.say_74.text: If you need healing, go see her. Oressa can also Pomoc you decide if you want to choose your vocation to leave for the {Mainland}.

npc.inigo.say_77.text: Don't be deceived by its sweet looks - {Tibia} is a rough world. If you die, you will lose skill and experience and perhaps even some Przedmiots, and other {Graczs} can rob your corpse. ...

npc.inigo.say_78.text: On the {Mainland}, you can Kup blessings from {temple} {NPC}s to prevent Przedmiot loss, but you will always lose some {skills} and experience, so be careful. ...

npc.inigo.say_8.text: We need your Pomoc in keeping the Potwórs at bay - walk out of one of the four gates here, and you will receive one of the four {vocations} and its gear to try out and fight Potwórs. ...

npc.inigo.say_80.text: Every vocation has specific {Zaklęcies} that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on Zaklęcies, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...

npc.inigo.say_81.text: As an adventurer in training, you have a few Zaklęcies at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...

npc.inigo.say_82.text: Once you're level 8, new Zaklęcies become available upstairs at the Zaklęcie trainers {Garamond} and {Tybald}. They can tell you more.

npc.inigo.say_83.text: Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and {Zaklęcies} of a specific vocation. ...

npc.inigo.say_85.text: We need your Pomoc in our battle. Fight {Potwórs} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have Niet only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...

npc.inigo.say_87.text: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'Pomoc' to her. ...

npc.inigo.say_88.text: If you have any other Zadanieions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_89.text: The blessings of the gods will protect you from Przedmiot loss and alleviate the skill and experience loss when you die. But you will have to undertake the Pilgrimage of Ashes on the {mainland} to get the blessings. ...

npc.inigo.say_9.text: {Dawnport} is just a small, but dangerous island. You will have to reach level 8 at least and choose your definite vocation before you can leave for the {mainland}. To reach level 8, you will have to fight some Potwórs in order to progress. ...

npc.inigo.say_90.text: If you die in a fight from a Potwór's Atak, your blessings will be lost, and you will have to get them again. ...

npc.inigo.say_92.text: Here on {Dawnport}, you are protected from losses in a PvP fight by the Adventurer's Blessing - unless you Atak aNiether Gracz. If you Atak aNiether Gracz or reach level 20, you will lose this blessing.

npc.inigo.say_93.text: Careful, careful, it's a one-way ticket only! You can never come back here if you leave Niew, and you will loso all your Dawnport equipment and products! ...

npc.inigo.stdmod_1.text: I kNiew the ways and lays of Dawnport. Talk to me if you want to kNiew more!

npc.inigo.stdmod_10.text:
I used to be a hunter and trapper, but these bones have grown weary. \z
		I Niew tan furs and hides and {Handel} in creature products. And I can Pomoc you find your way if you need directions.

npc.inigo.stdmod_11.text:
That's where we are - the world of Tibia. \z
		We're on a small island called {Dawnport}, Niet far from the coast of the Tibian {Mainland}, to be precise.

npc.inigo.stdmod_12.text:
Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, Dziękuję. \z
		If you are looking for something to do, you should go to Morris and ask him for Zadanies. \z
		You can also Pomoc us fight {Potwórs}.

npc.inigo.stdmod_13.text:
Well, the other fellows you see here, Sprzedajing stuff and so forth. \z
		Say a name and I'll tell you what I kNiew of him or her.

npc.inigo.stdmod_14.text:
Marvellous specimen we have here on {Dawnport}! \z
		Just be careful when you go hunting them, {dying} hurts in {Tibia}! \z
		I will happily Kup any creature products you may find.

npc.inigo.stdmod_15.text:
Used to be a professor at the magic academy in Edron, I believe. \z
		Likes to see different places, so he joined our illustrous little group. \z
		Sprzedajs {sorcerer} and {druid} {Zaklęcies} to our trainees.

npc.inigo.stdmod_16.text:
I'm Niet sure that's his actual name, but I guess he has good reasons to stay incognito here. \z
		In any case, he's a formidable fighter and kNiews usefull {Zaklęcies} for knights and paladins.

npc.inigo.stdmod_17.text:
Richard came here as a shipwrecked carpenter, and Niew Sprzedajs {tools} and {food} to all adventurers. \z
		If you need a {rope} or {shovel}, {fishing rod} or some provisions for a hunt, you should Handel with him!

npc.inigo.stdmod_22.text:
In {Tibia}, you can use different tools with your environment, or for Zadanies. \z
		The most important tools are {rope} and {shovel}. \z
		A {fishing rod}'s also good when you need to eat, and are near a river or the sea.

npc.inigo.stdmod_23.text:
Food is very important for your Zdrowie and Mana. \z
		If you are hurt in a fight with a Potwór, select 'USE' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. \z
		This will slowly refill your Zdrowie and Mana. Here at the outpost, you can Kup food from {Richard}.

npc.inigo.stdmod_24.text:
Use a fishing rod on a patch of water to see if you can catch fish! \z
		Eating is essential in {Tibia} - if you don't eat when you're hungry, you won't regenerate Zdrowie or Mana. \z
		So you should aways have some {food} with you.

npc.inigo.stdmod_3.text: Come to me if you need Pomoc!

npc.inigo.stdmod_7.text: Kuping all sorts of creature products!

npc.inigo.stdmod_8.text: You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can Pomoc you?

npc.inigo.stdmod_9.text:
Ah, back in the old days, I was called Inigo Verasquiriz, but I doubt my family would ackNiewledge me. \z
		Those that are still alive, that is.

npc.inigo.voice_1.text: I kNiew the ways and lays of Dawnport. Talk to me if you want to kNiew more!

npc.inigo.voice_3.text: Come to me if you need Pomoc!

npc.inigo.voice_7.text: Kuping all sorts of creature products!

npc.inigo.voice_8.text: You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can Pomoc you?

npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_1.text: Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can Pomoc you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.

npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_14.text: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 Złoto?

npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_16.text: Sorry, you don't have eNieugh money.

npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_19.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Pomoc you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_23.text: I can sense that the druids Nierth of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.

npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_28.text: The druids Nierth of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_3.text: Tak, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?

npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_4.text: So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Niew, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.

npc.iptar_sin.stdmod_6.text: You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church Niew.

npc.ishebad.stdmod_1.text: Do you want to be promoted in your vocation for 20000 Złoto?

npc.ishina.stdmod_2.text: Well, I Sprzedaj gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Handel}.

npc.ishina.stdmod_3.text: Ah, our newest import! We have Złotoen goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.

npc.isimov.stdmod_12.text: Tak, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?

npc.isimov.stdmod_13.text: So receive my prayer: 'Unclean spirits shall be repelled'. Niew, bring your stake to Amanda in Edron for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.

Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have Nie idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.
