npc.rashid.stdmod_13.text: When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the goverNier's daughter.

npc.rashid.stdmod_20.text: Although it's the flourishing Handel centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.

npc.rashid.stdmod_7.text: Cormaya? Niet a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.

npc.rashid.stdmod_8.text: It's Niet the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.

npc.rashid.stdmod_9.text: Ah Tak, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_1.text: I am a travelling Handelr. I don't Kup everything, though. And Niet from everyone, for that matter.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_10.text: Too few customers there, it's Niet worth the trip.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_13.text: When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the goverNier's daughter.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_20.text: Although it's the flourishing Handel centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_7.text: Cormaya? Niet a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_8.text: It's Niet the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_9.text: Ah Tak, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.

npc.rata_mari.greet_1.text: Meep? I mean - Witaj! Sorry, |GraczNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.

npc.rata_mari.stdmod_1.text: Your power of observation is stunning. Tak, I'm a rat.

npc.rata_mari.stdmod_2.text: Meep? I mean - Witaj! Sorry, |GraczNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_12.text: I Sprzedaj torches, candelabra, and oil.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_13.text: That guy is a shrewd Handelr, sweetie. I bet even I could learn a thing or two from him.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_14.text: I have shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, scrolls, watches, some lightsources, and other stuff. Just ask me for a {Handel}.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_16.text: Sadly the workers have hardly eNieugh money to Kup something to eat and to drink. That is bad also for my business.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_20.text: Thais might be a splendid town, but this is of Nie use to us here. The situation in our town gets worse with every ship full of foreigners that arrives here.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_21.text: I heard VeNiere will soon acquire several Handel moNiepolies that will grant them wealth for centuries.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_22.text: Well, <lowers the voice to a whisper> there are several people around who kNiew this or that about voodoo and Niet all of them are up to something good. Just Kup some lucky charms from that old hag Charlotta to be on the safe side.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_23.text: A handsome man but a bit too stiff. I think Nie one has ever had a chance to see him smiling.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_24.text: I will pay you 5 Złoto for every empty vial. Ok?

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_3.text: Uh! <whispers> There are ... rumours, you kNiew? About bloody rituals and gruesome curses ... better don't talk aloud about such issues.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_4.text: Kshh!! Nie talks about ... the magic folk here ... This might draw their attention.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_7.text: I am Niet dealing with food.

npc.richard.say_4.text: Niew, about that rope - ask me for {equipment} to see my wares. <winks>

npc.richard.stdmod_1.text: Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Kup one here, only the best quality!

npc.richard.stdmod_10.text:
You kNiew, I really don't want to poke into someone else's private life. \z
			Suffice it to say that everyone has chapters of his life he doesn't want to mention. \z
			Judging by Coltrayne's looks, we're looking at a trilogy here.

npc.richard.stdmod_14.text:
Don't kNiew what to make of him. Great researcher in all Dawnport matters, though. \z
			Always has a Zadanie or two where he needs Pomoc, if you're looking for adventuring work.

npc.richard.stdmod_15.text:
Quiet little lady, her. KNiews her way around the isle, looking for herbs and stuff \z
			but mostly spends her time in the temple, Pomocing younglings like you choose a vocation.

npc.richard.stdmod_16.text:
You kNiew, on the day that ol' pirate decides to make off with all that Złoto in the bank, \z
			I'm gonna come with him. Should be much more fun landing on a strange island with some Złoto \z
			to spend on booze and babes! <winks>

npc.richard.stdmod_2.text: Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can Kup one here Niew!

npc.richard.stdmod_6.text:
Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? \z
		Kup a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!

npc.richard.voice_1.text: Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Kup one here, only the best quality!

npc.richard.voice_2.text: Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can Kup one here Niew!

npc.richard.voice_6.text:
Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? \z
		Kup a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!

npc.riddler.stdmod_2.text: His name is Niene of your business

npc.riddler.stdmod_4.text: I am kNiewn as the riddler. That is all you need to kNiew.

npc.robson.voice_2.text: Just great. Getting stranded on a remote underground isle was Niet that bad but Niew I'm becoming a tourist attraction!

npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_1.text: Have you Nieticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to anNieunce: I'm a Handelr

npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_2.text: Nie, you got it all wrong! I said I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place!

npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_3.text: I can Pomoc you Kup trading stuff with you. Good for me, good for you. It's a win-win!

npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_4.text: Have you Nieticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to anNieunce: I'm a Handelr

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_12.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Pomoc you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_16.text: I can sense that the druids Nierth of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_21.text: The druids Nierth of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_7.text: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 Złoto?

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_9.text: Sorry, you don't have eNieugh money.

npc.romella.stdmod_3.text: I have many weapons to offer. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Handel}.

npc.romella.stdmod_4.text: I Sprzedaj and Kup weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Handel}.

npc.romella.stdmod_8.text: Make sure to Kup some extra weapons before facing that one.

npc.sam.stdmod_1.text: Witaj there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!

npc.sam.voice_1.text: Witaj there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!

npc.sandra.stdmod_1.text: Great spirit potions as well as Zdrowie and Mana potions in different sizes!

npc.sandra.stdmod_3.text: I Sprzedaj potions and fluids. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Handel}.

npc.sandra.voice_1.text: Great spirit potions as well as Zdrowie and Mana potions in different sizes!

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_2.text: What have I become? What is slime if it's Niet for everyone?

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_3.text: Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... Niet?

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_4.text: I AM THE... I mean... I am - what is a mage, if he is Niet {mad}? If he isn't... raging? I am... I am just sane. A sane mage.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_5.text: I am Niet mad... I- Tak, that's the whole problem, isn't it? What's going on, what's happening to me? I don't even kNiew anymore.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_6.text: Tak, well... I'm taking a break. It will take some time. I don't kNiew how long I just... I want to get away from all this for some time, that's it.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_7.text: Slime is my Misja. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right Niew at least.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_8.text: Slime is my Misja. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right Niew at least.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_9.text: You want to Pomoc me? Pomoc me? You? Who... who are you anyway? Ah nevermind.

npc.sane_mage.voice_2.text: What have I become? What is slime if it's Niet for everyone?

npc.sane_mage.voice_3.text: Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... Niet?

npc.santiago.voice_1.text: Evil little beasts... I hope someone Pomocs me fight them.

npc.santiago.voice_3.text: Hey! You over there, could you Pomoc me with a little Zadanie? Just say 'hi' or 'Witaj' to talk to me!

npc.santiago.voice_4.text: Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'Witaj' or 'hi'!

npc.ser_tybald.array_1.text:
Zaklęcies are very useful in combat - Niet only for mages, though of course we particularly \z
			rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_2.text:
There's a broad variety of what Zaklęcies can do, as you will see as you progress further. \z
			The next Zaklęcies you can Kup with level 8 and on. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_3.text:
Some Atak Zaklęcies can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an \z
			effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other Zaklęcies protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_4.text:
Each vocation has its own individual Zaklęcies that Niene of the other vocations can use. \z
			You can only learn Zaklęcies at a Zaklęcie trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_5.text:
The Zaklęcies here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once \z
			you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_6.text: There, you can go to a Zaklęcie teacher in a city to permanently learn a Zaklęcie.

npc.ser_tybald.say_1.text: Zaklęcies are very useful in combat - Niet only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_10.text: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce Potwórs that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_13.text: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to kNiew more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_14.text: I myself teach try-out Zaklęcies for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin Zaklęcies.

npc.ser_tybald.say_15.text: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' Nieises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_2.text: There's a broad variety of what Zaklęcies can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next Zaklęcies you can Kup with level 8 and on. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_3.text: Some Atak Zaklęcies can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other Zaklęcies protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_4.text: Each vocation has its own individual Zaklęcies that Niene of the other vocations can use. You can only learn Zaklęcies at a Zaklęcie trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_5.text: The Zaklęcies here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_6.text: There, you can go to a Zaklęcie teacher in a city to permanently learn a Zaklęcie.

npc.ser_tybald.say_7.text: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and Zadanies than this small isle, and also has Zaklęcie teachers where you can permanently learn a Zaklęcie for your vocation. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_8.text: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the Zaklęcie trainer of your vocation to learn a Zaklęcie. And make sure you have eNieugh Złoto! ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_9.text: The art of Zaklęcie teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable kNiewledge of a Zaklęcie to a Nievice if they can pay the price.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_11.text: Tak, child. If you wish to learn a Zaklęcie, tell me.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_12.text:
A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		Nie respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_13.text:
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do Niet kNiew. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_14.text:
Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Niet very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_15.text:
Niet a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, \z
		it seems to have lead him to discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_16.text:
He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of Zaklęcies for knights and paladins. \z
		If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_17.text:
Ah, Tak. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_4.text:
I can teach you {healing Zaklęcies}, {support Zaklęcies} and {Atak Zaklęcies}. \z
		What kind of Zaklęcie do you wish to learn?

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_6.text:
Did you Niet listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer Zaklęcies for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers Zaklęcies they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_8.text:
Oh, it's Niet too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_9.text:
A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any Zadanieion, ask Inigo for Pomoc.

npc.servant_sentry.stdmod_4.text: Our. Master. Is. Gone. You. Can. Niet. Visit. Him! We. Stand. {Sentry}!

npc.seymour.farewell_1.text: Good bye, |GraczNAME|! And remember: Nie running up and down in the academy!

npc.seymour.greet_1.text: Witaj, |GraczNAME|. Witamy to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?

npc.seymour.stdmod_1.text: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your Zadanieions!

npc.seymour.stdmod_100.text: Dixi Sprzedajs and Kups {armors}, {shields}, {helmets} and {legs}. You can find her shop south of the academy, just go up the stairs in {Obi}'s shop.

npc.seymour.stdmod_101.text: A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He Sprzedajs small Zdrowie {potions} just like {Lily}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_102.text: Lee'Delle's shop is in the western part of town, on the {premium} side. She Sprzedajs everything cheaper.

npc.seymour.stdmod_103.text: In the southern part of town, Lily Sprzedajs {potions} which might come in handy once you are deep in a dungeon and need {Zdrowie}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_105.text: Tak, Paulie is very important. He is the local {bank} clerk.

npc.seymour.stdmod_107.text: Tom the tanner Kups fresh {corpses}, miNietaur leather and paws. Always good to make some {money} if you can carry the corpses there fast eNieugh.

npc.seymour.stdmod_108.text: He's the guard on the Nierth {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {Potwór} locations. Just ask him about Potwórs!

npc.seymour.stdmod_109.text: He's the guard on the west {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {Potwór} locations. Just ask him about Potwórs!

npc.seymour.stdmod_18.text: Dziękuję! Here is a helmet that will serve you well.

npc.seymour.stdmod_20.text: Well, I would like to send our king a little present but I do Niet have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.

npc.seymour.stdmod_21.text: You are pretty inexperienced. I think killing rats is a suitable challenge for you. For each fresh {dead rat} I will give you two shiny coins of Złoto.

npc.seymour.stdmod_27.text: At least you kNiew how to address a man of my importance.

npc.seymour.stdmod_3.text: Feeling lost? Ask me for Pomoc!

npc.seymour.stdmod_30.text: In a bank you can deposit your earned Złoto coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.

npc.seymour.stdmod_31.text: Tak, depositing your money will keep it safe, so it is a good idea to store it in the bank. Of course, you can always withdraw it again.

npc.seymour.stdmod_33.text: Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any Nien-Gracz character and I will tell you something about him or her.

npc.seymour.stdmod_34.text: Merchants Kup and Sprzedaj goods. Just ask them for a {Handel} to see what they offer or Kup from you.

npc.seymour.stdmod_35.text: Trolls are quite nasty Potwórs which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!

npc.seymour.stdmod_36.text: The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {Potwórs} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.

npc.seymour.stdmod_4.text: Gain some kNiewledge in the academy!

npc.seymour.stdmod_42.text: We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the Nierth-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_44.text: The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {Zdrowie} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually Nietices emergencies by himself.

npc.seymour.stdmod_45.text: Your current Zdrowie is shown by the red bar on the right side. {Death} awaits you if it goes down to zero.

npc.seymour.stdmod_46.text: Dying in Tibia is painful, so try to avoid it. You will lose part of your {experience} points and also equipment. Make sure your {Zdrowie} always stays up!

npc.seymour.stdmod_47.text: You gain experience when fighting {Potwórs}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.

npc.seymour.stdmod_48.text: Good Potwórs to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.

npc.seymour.stdmod_5.text: Witaj, |GraczNAME|. Witamy to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?

npc.seymour.stdmod_53.text: Make money by killing {Potwórs} and picking up their {loot}. You can Sprzedaj many of the things they carry.

npc.seymour.stdmod_54.text: Once a Potwór is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other Przedmiots which you can Sprzedaj to {merchants}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_55.text: You can even Sprzedaj some corpses! For example, you can Sprzedaj fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also Kups other dead creatures, just ask him for a {Handel}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_56.text: You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Kup one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_57.text: A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large eNieugh to enter.

npc.seymour.stdmod_58.text: You should Niet descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {Potwórs}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_59.text: A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can Kup them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_60.text: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {Zadanie} if you're interested.

npc.seymour.stdmod_61.text: The starter armor, a coat, does Niet protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {Handel}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_62.text: The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and Kup a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {Handel}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_63.text: A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either Kup it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong eNieugh, {loot} them from {trolls}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_64.text: I fear you have to Kup your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.

npc.seymour.stdmod_65.text: Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either Kup them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong eNieugh, {loot} them from {trolls}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_66.text: Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can Kup them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong eNieugh, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_67.text: Many Potwórs, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also Kup food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.

npc.seymour.stdmod_69.text: Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Niet that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...

npc.seymour.stdmod_70.text: Use a small Zdrowie potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 Zdrowie points. You can Kup them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.

npc.seymour.stdmod_71.text: Some Potwórs poison you. To heal poison, use an antidote potion on yourself. Kup them at {Lily}'s store.

npc.seymour.stdmod_73.text: The island is separated into a {premium} side and a Nien-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other Graczs.

npc.seymour.stdmod_76.text: There is a bridge to the Nierth and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.

npc.seymour.stdmod_78.text: You have to fight {Potwórs} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {Zdrowie}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_79.text: The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right Niew though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_8.text: Only Niensense on your mind, eh?

npc.seymour.stdmod_80.text: Once you gained eNieugh experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {Zdrowie} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.

npc.seymour.stdmod_81.text: The farms are west of here. You can Kup and Sprzedaj {food} there which you need to regain {Zdrowie}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_82.text: To Atak a rat, simply click on it in your battle list. Make sure that you have proper {equipment}, though! Also, I give you 2 Złoto coins for each {dead rat}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_83.text: I personally don't have anything to Handel, but you can ask {merchants} for a Handel. That will open a window where you can see their offers and the things they Kup from you.

npc.seymour.stdmod_84.text: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {Zadanie} if you're interested.

npc.seymour.stdmod_9.text: Good bye, |GraczNAME|! And remember: Nie running up and down in the academy!

npc.seymour.stdmod_90.text: Obi Sprzedajs and Kups {weapons}. You can find his shop south of the academy.

npc.gnomus.kw_base_2.text: Our kNiewledge of the enemy and it's tactics would be of more use if the dwarves would listen to us somewhat more. But gNiemes have learned to live with the imperfection of the other races.

npc.iskan.kw_bonelords_3.text: And there I've seen such a creature. The boys went almost mad and I turned my sled immediately. Nie idea how we made it home. True story.

npc.gerimor.kw_me_2.text: We are watching and evaluating what is happening in our world.	Trying to avert the worst and offering a Pomocing hand where we deem it needed. ...

npc.gerimor.kw_me_3.text: We usually avoid to interfere directly in the affairs of the world and vain politics are Niet our concern at all.

npc.gerimor.kw_dawn_1.text: Even we kNiew the individual that was somewhat of our funder, only as the wise man. ...

npc.gerimor.kw_dawn_3.text: The order predates mankind and never bothered to give itself a name. Such assumptions of pretence and vanity have Nie place in our mindset.

npc.gerimor.kw_guidance_1.text: Most times we are silent watchers and keeper of kNiewledge that share what they have learned with each other. We are more concerned about kNiewledge and wisdom and power means little to us. ...

npc.gerimor.kw_direct_2.text: It is gladly a rare occurrence and usually it is sufficient to somewhat offer a guiding hand to avert a course that would lead to more dire consequences. Nienetheless sometimes we have to interfere.

npc.gerimor.kw_pookas_2.text: Pookas love to play pranks on others, snitching and hiding things or telling made-up stories. They are capricious and fickle creatures. Pookas emerge from mortals' dreams about gems, treasures and Złoto. ...

npc.gerimor.kw_swan_maidens_1.text: Swan maidens are fae who can shapeshift from human form to swan form. The magical Przedmiot allowing this transformation is a swan feather cloak, a garment with swan feathers attached. ...

npc.gerimor.kw_nymphs_1.text: Nymphs are female nature spirits and usually take the form of beautiful, young maidens who love to dance and sing. They dwell in the hills and forests of Feyrist, often near lakes and streams and they can't die of old age Nier illness. ...

npc.gerimor.kw_boogies_2.text: Only at night, they are roaming the surface, chasing other fae and visitors to Feyrist alike. They were once clumsy yet peaceful fae, but they are Niew twisted and tainted by a mysterious, sinister force.

npc.gerimor.kw_maelyrra_1.text: She's the queen of a fae court. You can find her on a glade in the deep forest. It was queen Maelyrra who granted me perMisja to stay here in Feyrist. ...

npc.gerimor.kw_cults_2.text: The connection is of second thought though. Connected or Niet, they further the death of our world. That alone makes it imperative to dig those cults out and destroy their cores. ...

npc.gerimor.kw_cults_3.text: We won't be able to rout our each and any movement but if we Manage to neutralize the worst, we gain some time and deny the enemy much of its leverage on the future of our world.

npc.gerimor.kw_works_2.text: that understanding it is either impossible or twist a mind in ways that are Niet meant to be. Also the Yalahari who figured out way too much about the thing, became tainted and changed by this kNiewledge ...

npc.gerimor.kw_works_3.text: And ultimately Niet only fell and became his, they also provided the thing with something of their own, be it kNiewledge, understanding or even direction, purpose. ...

npc.gerimor.kw_works_4.text: In some way their tainted kNiewledge brought the unthinkable into a resemblance of existence. ...

npc.cipfried.stdmod_1.text: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or Hilfe!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_11.text: That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {Monsters}, {Quests} and {citizens} around.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_12.text: How can I Hilfe you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_13.text: Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {Handel} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_14.text: I don't have any goods for Handel, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can Kaufen or Verkaufen.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_15.text: A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful Neint to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_18.text: Did you kNeinw that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!

npc.flickering_soul.array_1.text: I was once kNeinwn as the necromant king. ...

npc.flickering_soul.array_2.text: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just aNeinther stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.

npc.flickering_soul.array_3.text: Neinw I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.

npc.flickering_soul.say_13.text: I'm Neint aware of the fate of my linage. Neither I'm able to relate to the mortal world in that way. Each of us is an individual, Neint bound by ties of blood or herritage.

npc.flickering_soul.say_14.text: His avatar might be destroyed for Neinw and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be annihilated this easy.

npc.flickering_soul.say_16.text: I have cleansed you from the taints that you carried with you. You are Neinw free from the burden that you should Neint have to bear.

npc.flickering_soul.say_17.text: You are Neint tainted by the darkness of the world. You are pure and free from the burdens that others carry.

npc.flickering_soul.say_18.text: I was once kNeinwn as the necromant king. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_19.text: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just aNeinther stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.

npc.flickering_soul.say_20.text: My ambitions were high and knew Nein limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_21.text: Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been eNeinugh. There was a hunger in me that Neinthing could put to rest.

npc.flickering_soul.say_22.text: I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me Neint have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was Nein time to rest. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_23.text: And there was Nein looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_24.text: Neinw I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.

npc.flickering_soul.say_25.text: Zarganash was Neint a place without its dangers, but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_3.text: Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen Neinthing mattered but me and my ambitions.

npc.flickering_soul.say_31.text: Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did Neint lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments. But the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_32.text: I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of kNeinwledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this kNeinwledge wasn't about power. It was about me.

npc.flickering_soul.say_37.text: They are beginning to feed Neint only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker, they grow more powerful over time.

npc.flickering_soul.say_38.text: You did it! For the first time I can feel free from the pull of my past. Neinw I'm free at last. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_39.text: I might stay a while and teach other souls about the inner peace, but will eventually pass on. Danke so much, my hero. My eternal gratitude and blessings will be with you!

npc.flickering_soul.say_4.text: Necromancy was a passion at first, aNeinther tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.

npc.flickering_soul.say_5.text: My demise did Neint meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.

npc.flickering_soul.say_6.text: My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had Neint taken into consideration was peace.

npc.flickering_soul.say_7.text: I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided Neint to return to the world of the living.

npc.flickering_soul.say_9.text: I'm aware I have Nein right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you Neinnetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?

npc.frodo.stdmod_11.text: Ah Ja, the graveyard dungeon. All I kNeinw is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. Nein idea what that means, though!

npc.frodo.stdmod_13.text: Ja, I remember him. His name was Berfasmur.

npc.garamond.say_1.text: Zaubers are very useful in combat - Neint only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.garamond.say_10.text: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce Monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...

npc.garamond.say_13.text: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to kNeinw more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...

npc.garamond.say_14.text: I myself teach try-out Zaubers for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin Zaubers.

npc.garamond.say_15.text: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' Neinises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...

npc.garamond.say_2.text: There's a broad variety of what Zaubers can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next Zaubers you can Kaufen with level 8 and on. ...

npc.garamond.say_7.text: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and Quests than this small isle, and also has Zauber teachers where you can permanently learn a Zauber for your vocation. ...

npc.garamond.say_8.text: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the Zauber trainer of your vocation to learn a Zauber. And make sure you have eNeinugh Gold! ...

npc.gerimor.stdmod_3.text: We might Neint be many but we are diverse. Our rather informal order came together in the dawn of time, when the wars of the gods ravaged the world.

npc.gerimor.stdmod_5.text: The fae granted me perMission to enter their hidden realm. As a druid I'm in close touch with nature so I could gain their trust. The nature spirits are inhabiting this peninsula for ages.

npc.gerimor.stdmod_7.text: Spare lives where you see it fit but the cults may Neint be allowed to exist and disrupt the fabric of the world even more.

npc.gerimor.stdmod_9.text: I have several Missions available that deal with servering the ties of the corrupting influence on our world.

npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_8.text: In their vanity our descendants thought they could use those false-born as servants. They paid a terrible price. Their downfall might only be temporary though if we can {redeem} our race in the eJa of the snake god.

npc.hamish.say_3.text: Dawnport is Neint far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, Monsters, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with Nein sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself>

npc.henricus.stdmod_10.text: Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin Neinwadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.

npc.henricus.stdmod_14.text: We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eJa open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.

npc.henricus.stdmod_15.text: The church of CruNeinr works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.

npc.henricus.stdmod_18.text: The churches of the gods entrusted me with the eNeinrmous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.

npc.henricus.stdmod_2.text: Neinwadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the Neinble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.

npc.henricus.stdmod_9.text: VeNeinre is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.

npc.inigo.say_11.text: If you have any other Questions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_12.text: There are many dangers in {Tibia}. You may have to defend yourself Neint only against {Monsters}, but if {PvP} is allowed, against other {Spielers}, too. ...

npc.inigo.say_16.text: Depending on the world you chose in {Tibia}, {Spielers} may attack you at all times or only if you consent. ...

npc.inigo.say_17.text: On an Optional PvP world, PvP is only possible if both Spielers consent to it; but on Open PvP or Hardcore PvP worlds, any Spieler may always attack you, so be watchful. ...

npc.inigo.say_18.text: A brown frame around a Spieler indicates he or she is in a PvP situation. A {skull} next to a Spieler name means he or she attacked or killed aNeinther Spieler. ...

npc.inigo.say_19.text: Here on {Dawnport}, PvP is Neint allowed inside the outpost, and Neint possible until you have reached level 8 at least. If you have any other Questions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_2.text: But we didn't find any conclusive hints. {Menesto} and a few others volunteered to guard the portal from the {Monsters} of this isle. You say you came through it from your world! Astounding. ...

npc.inigo.say_20.text: To chat with other Spielers, you can click on one of the chat channels and see who is posting in there. ...

npc.inigo.say_21.text: If you want to message a specific Spieler, right-click on his or her name and select 'Message to <Spieler name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.

npc.inigo.say_22.text: NPC means someone like me or {Hamish} or {Coltrayne}, for example. You can easily discern us from {Spielers} like you, because there is a speech bubble next to our {name}. ...

npc.inigo.say_23.text: We all have our different ways, but Neinrmally, addressing an NPC with 'hi' or 'Hallo' will open a conversation. ...

npc.inigo.say_24.text: Some NPCs will have secret words that they react to that are Neint highlighted in their conversation. In that case, you need to type in your Question. ...

npc.inigo.say_26.text: You can try this out by asking an NPC about their {job}, as this is a keyword most will react to. If you have any other Questions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_27.text: Every vocation has specific Zaubers that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on Zaubers, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...

npc.inigo.say_28.text: As an adventurer in training, you have a few Zaubers at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...

npc.inigo.say_29.text: Once you're level 8, new Zaubers become available upstairs at the Zauber trainers {Garamond} and {Tybald}. They can tell you more.

npc.inigo.say_3.text: You couldn't have chosen a better time. We really need Hilfe against the Monsters that swarm this island, and the whole world of {Tibia}. If you're unsure on how to {Hilfe} exactly, I can give you directions.

npc.inigo.say_31.text: Shovels can be bought at {Richard}'s, like the other equipment, or food. If you don't have the money yet, go out and kill some {Monsters} outside - and maybe you'll even find a shovel, who kNeinws!

npc.inigo.say_32.text: We found the island following a strange glow we saw at night, close before dawn. We were looking for a source of unkNeinwn, powerful magic, and it seemed that this island was its source. ...

npc.inigo.say_33.text: When we arrived, we found goblins, miNeintaurs, trolls and undead warring on this island. We wondered why. Then they seemed to reach an agreement, and settled down in the caves. We decided to investigate. ...

npc.inigo.say_34.text: That is when we found the strange crystal {portal}, through which you came. Perhaps this is why the {Monsters} battle, but won't leave. ...

npc.inigo.say_35.text: It certainly is a place of power, so {Menesto}'s group was sent down to guard it. However, we are but few, so we need every Hilfe we can get to defend and maintain the outpost on this isle. ...

npc.inigo.say_36.text: That is why we need your Hilfe - choose the vocation that suits you, take up its arms and Hilfe us defend this place against the evil that wants to claim it! If you need any Hilfe in how to do these things, ask me.

npc.inigo.say_37.text: The mainland harbours the most ancient cities of {Tibia}, and many dangers and adventures as well. When you have Hilfeed us defend {Dawnport}, and learned eNeinugh of the ways of Tibia to reach level 8 at least, you should leave for the mainland. ...

npc.inigo.say_39.text: Premium adventurers can also sail to the many islands that surround the mainland, which offer many more dangers and mysteries to be explored; and you can do Quests to ride mounts, and dress in a variety of new outfits.

npc.inigo.say_40.text: Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and {Zaubers} of a specific vocation. ...

npc.inigo.say_42.text: We need your Hilfe in our battle. Fight {Monsters} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have Neint only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...

npc.inigo.say_44.text: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'Hilfe' to her. ...

npc.inigo.say_45.text: If you have any other Questions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_47.text: You need to choose your vocation before you can leave {Dawnport} to go to the {Mainland}. But first, you have to gain eNeinugh experience to reach level 8 in order to do so. ...

npc.inigo.say_49.text: If you have any other Questions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_5.text: ... But of course, you met him. ... So it really is a portal, and you came through it from aNeinther plane of existence! I never quite believed the tales of old, Neint really. But Neinw... it's wonderful, truly wonderful. ...

npc.inigo.say_51.text: I can also tell you how to talk with other {Spielers} or {NPC}s, or can inform you about {Questing} or {Zaubers}. ...

npc.inigo.say_52.text: I also have a list of small {hints} if you prefer that, and can tell you something of the {people} here. Just tell me what you want to kNeinw. ...

npc.inigo.say_53.text: Oh, but first that Hilfe I mentioned - you should get yourself a {shovel}, friend. It will come in handy when you set about finding secret entrances to dungeons or hidden treasures - many useful things lie hidden beneath earth, sand or stones!

npc.inigo.say_54.text: Offensive {fighting} means you deal harder attacks, but have a weaker defense. Magical damage you deal is Neint affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_55.text: You should switch to offensive only if you want to finish off a Monster quickly and are sure you can survive its harder attacks. I can also tell you something about {balanced} and {defensive} fighting.

npc.inigo.say_56.text: Balanced {fighting} balances out your attack strength as well as your defense strength. Magical damage you deal is Neint affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_58.text: Defensive {fighting} increases your defense but reduces your attack strength. The magical damage you deal is Neint affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_6.text: Well, if you have any Questions as to THIS plane of existence, which we call {Tibia}, just ask me. I can give directions, {hints}, you name it. <winks at you>

npc.inigo.say_60.text: A white skull means that this Spieler attacked and maybe killed aNeinther Spieler without justification. ...

npc.inigo.say_61.text: A red skull means someone has killed many other {Spielers}, while a black skull depicts someone on a serious killing spree - so watch out!

npc.inigo.say_62.text: Some sort of misguided genius, I think. Brilliant with potions and runes, but couldn't get on with his master or with the other students. Ran away and set up his own little lab, Verkaufening to travellers along the road. ...

npc.inigo.say_64.text: Coltrayne doesn't say much about himself. What I gathered from the 15 years I've kNeinwn him is that he was raised by a blacksmith as a foundling. ...

npc.inigo.say_66.text: Ah, there are lots of stories about Morris. Likes to insist on the 'Mr'. Neinbody kNeinws his first name, and the telling goes that he has gambled with a demon and lost his first name to him. ...

npc.inigo.say_68.text: Anyway. One way or aNeinther, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. Neint sure that sending others on Missions is really all it's about for him, but if you're looking for a Quest, go ask Morris for one.

npc.inigo.say_69.text: Neint your level, but your skill with your weapon determines how much damage you make. With a distance weapon like a bow, you {train} your distance {fighting} skill, with a sword your sword fighting, etc. ...

npc.inigo.say_7.text: Our world {Tibia} is swarmed by many dangerous {Monsters}, so {fighting} is something you will have to learn and master quickly. You can fight as a {sorcerer}, druid, {paladin} or {knight}. ...

npc.inigo.say_70.text: Druids and sorcerers train their magic level by using their mana through {Zaubers} and runes. Their wand or rod damage is Neint affected by their magic level. If you have any other Questions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_72.text: You can Kaufen a rope over at {Richard}'s shop. If you don't have the money, kill and loot a few {Monsters} - maybe one of them even has a rope with it, that sort of thing happens.

npc.inigo.say_73.text: Our local healer. Don't kNeinw why that druid girl decided she wanted the unsteady life of an adventurer, but she's quite hardy, to tell the truth. I once saw her confront a polar bear.... but I'm getting carried away. ...

npc.inigo.say_74.text: If you need healing, go see her. Oressa can also Hilfe you decide if you want to choose your vocation to leave for the {Mainland}.

npc.inigo.say_77.text: Don't be deceived by its sweet looks - {Tibia} is a rough world. If you die, you will lose skill and experience and perhaps even some Gegenstands, and other {Spielers} can rob your corpse. ...

npc.inigo.say_78.text: On the {Mainland}, you can Kaufen blessings from {temple} {NPC}s to prevent Gegenstand loss, but you will always lose some {skills} and experience, so be careful. ...

npc.inigo.say_8.text: We need your Hilfe in keeping the Monsters at bay - walk out of one of the four gates here, and you will receive one of the four {vocations} and its gear to try out and fight Monsters. ...

npc.inigo.say_87.text: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'Hilfe' to her. ...

npc.inigo.say_88.text: If you have any other Questions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_89.text: The blessings of the gods will protect you from Gegenstand loss and alleviate the skill and experience loss when you die. But you will have to undertake the Pilgrimage of Ashes on the {mainland} to get the blessings. ...

npc.inigo.say_9.text: {Dawnport} is just a small, but dangerous island. You will have to reach level 8 at least and choose your definite vocation before you can leave for the {mainland}. To reach level 8, you will have to fight some Monsters in order to progress. ...

npc.inigo.say_90.text: If you die in a fight from a Monster's attack, your blessings will be lost, and you will have to get them again. ...

Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have Nein idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.

npc.santiago.voice_4.text: Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'Hallo' or 'hi'!

npc.ser_tybald.array_1.text:
Zaubers are very useful in combat - Neint only for mages, though of course we particularly \z
			rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_2.text:
There's a broad variety of what Zaubers can do, as you will see as you progress further. \z
			The next Zaubers you can Kaufen with level 8 and on. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_3.text:
Some attack Zaubers can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an \z
			effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other Zaubers protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_4.text:
Each vocation has its own individual Zaubers that Neinne of the other vocations can use. \z
			You can only learn Zaubers at a Zauber trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_5.text:
The Zaubers here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once \z
			you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_6.text: There, you can go to a Zauber teacher in a city to permanently learn a Zauber.

npc.ser_tybald.say_1.text: Zaubers are very useful in combat - Neint only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_10.text: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce Monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_13.text: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to kNeinw more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_14.text: I myself teach try-out Zaubers for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin Zaubers.

npc.ser_tybald.say_15.text: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' Neinises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_2.text: There's a broad variety of what Zaubers can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next Zaubers you can Kaufen with level 8 and on. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_3.text: Some attack Zaubers can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other Zaubers protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_4.text: Each vocation has its own individual Zaubers that Neinne of the other vocations can use. You can only learn Zaubers at a Zauber trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_5.text: The Zaubers here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_6.text: There, you can go to a Zauber teacher in a city to permanently learn a Zauber.

npc.ser_tybald.say_7.text: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and Quests than this small isle, and also has Zauber teachers where you can permanently learn a Zauber for your vocation. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_8.text: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the Zauber trainer of your vocation to learn a Zauber. And make sure you have eNeinugh Gold! ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_9.text: The art of Zauber teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable kNeinwledge of a Zauber to a Neinvice if they can pay the price.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_11.text: Ja, child. If you wish to learn a Zauber, tell me.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_12.text:
A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		Nein respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_13.text:
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do Neint kNeinw. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_14.text:
Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Neint very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_15.text:
Neint a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, \z
		it seems to have lead him to discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_16.text:
He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of Zaubers for knights and paladins. \z
		If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_17.text:
Ah, Ja. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_4.text:
I can teach you {healing Zaubers}, {support Zaubers} and {attack Zaubers}. \z
		What kind of Zauber do you wish to learn?

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_6.text:
Did you Neint listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer Zaubers for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers Zaubers they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_8.text:
Oh, it's Neint too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_9.text:
A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any Question, ask Inigo for Hilfe.

npc.servant_sentry.stdmod_4.text: Our. Master. Is. Gone. You. Can. Neint. Visit. Him! We. Stand. {Sentry}!

npc.seymour.farewell_1.text: Good bye, |SpielerNAME|! And remember: Nein running up and down in the academy!

npc.seymour.greet_1.text: Hallo, |SpielerNAME|. Willkommen to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?

npc.seymour.stdmod_1.text: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your Questions!

npc.seymour.stdmod_100.text: Dixi Verkaufens and Kaufens {armors}, {shields}, {helmets} and {legs}. You can find her shop south of the academy, just go up the stairs in {Obi}'s shop.

npc.seymour.stdmod_101.text: A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He Verkaufens small health {potions} just like {Lily}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_102.text: Lee'Delle's shop is in the western part of town, on the {premium} side. She Verkaufens everything cheaper.

npc.seymour.stdmod_103.text: In the southern part of town, Lily Verkaufens {potions} which might come in handy once you are deep in a dungeon and need {health}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_105.text: Ja, Paulie is very important. He is the local {bank} clerk.

npc.seymour.stdmod_107.text: Tom the tanner Kaufens fresh {corpses}, miNeintaur leather and paws. Always good to make some {money} if you can carry the corpses there fast eNeinugh.

npc.seymour.stdmod_108.text: He's the guard on the Neinrth {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {Monster} locations. Just ask him about Monsters!

npc.seymour.stdmod_109.text: He's the guard on the west {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {Monster} locations. Just ask him about Monsters!

npc.seymour.stdmod_18.text: Danke! Here is a helmet that will serve you well.

npc.seymour.stdmod_20.text: Well, I would like to send our king a little present but I do Neint have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.

npc.seymour.stdmod_21.text: You are pretty inexperienced. I think killing rats is a suitable challenge for you. For each fresh {dead rat} I will give you two shiny coins of Gold.

npc.seymour.stdmod_27.text: At least you kNeinw how to address a man of my importance.

npc.seymour.stdmod_3.text: Feeling lost? Ask me for Hilfe!

npc.seymour.stdmod_30.text: In a bank you can deposit your earned Gold coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.

npc.seymour.stdmod_31.text: Ja, depositing your money will keep it safe, so it is a good idea to store it in the bank. Of course, you can always withdraw it again.

npc.seymour.stdmod_33.text: Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any Neinn-Spieler character and I will tell you something about him or her.

npc.seymour.stdmod_34.text: Merchants Kaufen and Verkaufen goods. Just ask them for a {Handel} to see what they offer or Kaufen from you.

npc.seymour.stdmod_35.text: Trolls are quite nasty Monsters which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!

npc.seymour.stdmod_36.text: The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {Monsters} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.

npc.seymour.stdmod_4.text: Gain some kNeinwledge in the academy!

npc.seymour.stdmod_42.text: We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the Neinrth-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_44.text: The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually Neintices emergencies by himself.

npc.seymour.stdmod_47.text: You gain experience when fighting {Monsters}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.

npc.seymour.stdmod_48.text: Good Monsters to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.

npc.seymour.stdmod_5.text: Hallo, |SpielerNAME|. Willkommen to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?

npc.seymour.stdmod_53.text: Make money by killing {Monsters} and picking up their {loot}. You can Verkaufen many of the things they carry.

npc.seymour.stdmod_54.text: Once a Monster is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other Gegenstands which you can Verkaufen to {merchants}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_55.text: You can even Verkaufen some corpses! For example, you can Verkaufen fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also Kaufens other dead creatures, just ask him for a {Handel}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_56.text: You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Kaufen one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_57.text: A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large eNeinugh to enter.

npc.seymour.stdmod_58.text: You should Neint descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {Monsters}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_59.text: A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can Kaufen them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_60.text: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {Quest} if you're interested.

npc.seymour.stdmod_61.text: The starter armor, a coat, does Neint protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {Handel}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_62.text: The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and Kaufen a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {Handel}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_63.text: A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either Kaufen it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong eNeinugh, {loot} them from {trolls}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_64.text: I fear you have to Kaufen your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.

npc.seymour.stdmod_65.text: Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either Kaufen them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong eNeinugh, {loot} them from {trolls}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_66.text: Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can Kaufen them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong eNeinugh, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_67.text: Many Monsters, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also Kaufen food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.

npc.seymour.stdmod_69.text: Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Neint that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...

npc.seymour.stdmod_70.text: Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can Kaufen them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.

npc.seymour.stdmod_71.text: Some Monsters poison you. To heal poison, use an antidote potion on yourself. Kaufen them at {Lily}'s store.

npc.seymour.stdmod_73.text: The island is separated into a {premium} side and a Neinn-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other Spielers.

npc.seymour.stdmod_76.text: There is a bridge to the Neinrth and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.

npc.seymour.stdmod_78.text: You have to fight {Monsters} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {health}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_79.text: The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right Neinw though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_8.text: Only Neinnsense on your mind, eh?

npc.seymour.stdmod_80.text: Once you gained eNeinugh experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {health} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.

npc.seymour.stdmod_81.text: The farms are west of here. You can Kaufen and Verkaufen {food} there which you need to regain {health}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_82.text: To attack a rat, simply click on it in your battle list. Make sure that you have proper {equipment}, though! Also, I give you 2 Gold coins for each {dead rat}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_83.text: I personally don't have anything to Handel, but you can ask {merchants} for a Handel. That will open a window where you can see their offers and the things they Kaufen from you.

npc.seymour.stdmod_84.text: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {Quest} if you're interested.

npc.seymour.stdmod_9.text: Good bye, |SpielerNAME|! And remember: Nein running up and down in the academy!

npc.seymour.stdmod_90.text: Obi Verkaufens and Kaufens {weapons}. You can find his shop south of the academy.

npc.seymour.stdmod_91.text: Neinrma has recently opened a bar here meaning she Verkaufens drinks and snacks. Neinthing of importance to you, young student.

npc.seymour.stdmod_92.text: Oh, let's Neint talk about Loui.

npc.seymour.stdmod_93.text: A fine and Hilfeful man. Without him, many new adventurers would be quite clueless.

npc.seymour.stdmod_95.text: Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the Neinrth-western part of the village. He Verkaufens useful stuff such as {ropes}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_96.text: A traveller from the {main} continent. I wonder what brought her here. Nein one comes here of his own free will.

npc.seymour.stdmod_98.text: Willie is a fine farmer, although he is short-tempered. He Verkaufens and Kaufens {food}.

npc.seymour.voice_1.text: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your Questions!

npc.seymour.voice_3.text: Feeling lost? Ask me for Hilfe!

npc.seymour.voice_4.text: Gain some kNeinwledge in the academy!

npc.shanar.voice_2.text: Looking for protective Zaubers for druids? I can teach you.

npc.shauna.stdmod_17.text: I bet they spy on us... Neint my business, however.

npc.shauna.stdmod_31.text: I deal more with the human mosters, you kNeinw? HO, HO, HO!

npc.shauna.stdmod_33.text: The only thing that rebels here Neinw and then is the stomach of a male after trying to make illegal alcohol. HO, HO, HO!

npc.shauna.stdmod_5.text: Would you like to Kaufen the general key to the town?

npc.shoddy_beggar.voice_2.text: That astroNeinmer of the academy simply has Nein idea what he is dealing with...

npc.simon_the_beggar.voice_2.text: Sir, Ma'am, have a Gold coin to spare?

npc.simon_the_beggar.voice_3.text: I need Hilfe! Please Hilfe me!

npc.sinclair.voice_3.text: Ja indeed, all of the equipment should be checked and calibrated regularly.

npc.sinclair.voice_4.text: Nein, we have to give this aNeinther go.

npc.sister_of_jack.voice_2.text: Mother?! Oh Nein, Neinw I have to do this all over again

npc.spectulus.stdmod_10.text: The people of Edron were digging there for minerals and Gold. It seemed all that work was of Nein avail when they finally hit the motherlode. Gems, rare crystals and... water. So much that it flooded the whole system. And Neint a single soul escaped.

npc.spectulus.stdmod_11.text: I heard rumours of a fabled creature whose traces were found on an island near Carlin. It lives solely to collect all kinds of rare gems, crystals and minerals. Offering an Gegenstand it does Neint already own, reportedly allows passage into its lair.

npc.spectulus.stdmod_3.text: Looks like I have to find aNeinther way then.

npc.spectulus.stdmod_5.text: I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will Neint rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.

npc.spectulus.stdmod_6.text: I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will Neint rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.

npc.spectulus.stdmod_7.text: I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will Neint rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.

npc.spectulus.voice_3.text: Looks like I have to find aNeinther way then.

npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_1.text: I can't reveal much to you right Neinw as time is of the essence. I can tell you though that the glooth plant and the whole town are in danger and we have to act to stop a {madman} and his schemes.

npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_3.text: The creature is powerful but Neint very clever. It seems it can be easily {enraged} and then it would likely let slip all caution and would relentlessly attack without regard for its safety.

npc.strange_pipe1.stdmod_1.text: I can't reveal much to you right Neinw as time is of the essence. I can tell you though that the glooth plant and the whole town are in danger and we have to act to stop a {madman} and his schemes.

npc.strange_pipe1.stdmod_3.text: The creature is powerful but Neint very clever. It seems it can be easily {enraged} and then it would likely let slip all caution and would relentlessly attack without regard for its safety.

npc.sundara.voice_1.text: Health potions! Mana potions! Kaufen them here!

npc.swolt.stdmod_1.text: Well, you see me standing behind a bar. Verkaufening drinks. Food. And stuff. Neinw try figuring out what I could be making a living of down here.

npc.swolt.stdmod_2.text: I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. And as drinks we serve beer and water. If you'd like to see what we have to offer, just ask me for a Handel.

npc.talila.voice_1.text: Are you interested in a Handel?

npc.the_beggar_king.array_3.text: The city sealed those parts off, and I have Nein idea how anything could get in or out without the perMission of the magistrate. ...

npc.the_beggar_king.array_4.text: But since you are investigating on their behalf, you might work out some agreement with them, if you're mad eNeinugh to enter the sewers at all. ...

npc.the_beggar_king.say_3.text: The city sealed those parts off, and I have Nein idea how anything could get in or out without the perMission of the magistrate. ...

npc.the_beggar_king.say_4.text: But since you are investigating on their behalf, you might work out some agreement with them, if you're mad eNeinugh to enter the sewers at all. ...

npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_1.text: Me put name away name long ago. Neinw only blind prophet of ape people are.

npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_10.text: Our people a lot to learn have. One day we might live in peace with you hairless apes, who kNeinws.

npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_11.text: Me Neint kNeinw. Me seldom have visions of Neint banana related objects.

npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_7.text: Good ape he is. Has to work hard to make other apes listen but you Hilfeed a lot.

npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_8.text: Our holy ancestor he is. Big as mountain. Lizards say they built palisade to keep him but we Neint believe ... We think Bong palisade built to have peace from pesky lizards. We respect peace of Bong, keep people away from forbidden land.

npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_1.text: Times have changed <sigh>. In the past dragons were feared and respected. Only the {demons} rivalled our Neintoriety.

npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_4.text: Your lives are so short and meaningless and yet you are here! And as a race you even have your own history and remember things with the Hilfe of {books}, which amazes me.

npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_6.text: Lava is only fun as long as it doesn't harden - then it turns into an anNeinyance.

npc.the_librarian.voice_3.text: Someone opened the Grimoire of Flames without perMission. Egregious!

npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_15.text: His ancient fortress on Darama was deserted as the evil Djinn fled this world after his imprisonment. Neinw the time has come for the evil Djinns to return to their master although this will certainly awaken the {good Djinn} too.

npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_16.text: I will Neint share anything more about that topic with you {paleskins}.

npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_17.text: You are as ugly as maggots, although Neint quite as as tasty.

npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_3.text: I'm the {guardian} of the {SEVENTH} and final seal. The seal to open the last door before ... but perhaps it's better to see it with your own eJa.

npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_6.text: This ancient race was annihilated by its own doings, that's all I kNeinw. Aeons have passed since then, but the sheer presence of this {complex} is still defiling and desecrating this area.

npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_7.text: Its constructors were too strange for you or even me to understand. We don't kNeinw what this ... thing they built was supposed to be good for. I feel a constant twisting and binding of souls, though, that is probably only a side-effect.

npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_8.text: The place you kNeinw as the Ghostlands had a different name once ... and many names after. Too many to remember them all.

npc.thorgrin.stdmod_4.text: Do you want me take you to {Cormaya}, {Kazordoon} or {GNeinmprona}?

npc.thorwulf.stdmod_3.text:
I can teach you {healing Zaubers}, {attack Zaubers} and {support Zaubers}. \z
		What kind of Zauber do you wish to learn? \z
		You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a Zauber, if you prefer that.

npc.tibra.stdmod_11.text: The teachings of CruNeinr tell us to hoNeinr life and Neint to harm it.

npc.tibra.stdmod_12.text: It is my Mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.

npc.tibra.stdmod_13.text: It is my Mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.

npc.tibra.stdmod_14.text: My name is Tibra. Your soul tells me that you are |SpielerNAME|.

npc.tibra.stdmod_15.text: Queen Eloise is wise to listen to the proposals of the druidic followers of CruNeinr.

npc.tibra.stdmod_16.text: The grace of the gods must be earned, it canNeint be bought!

npc.tibra.stdmod_19.text: There's something strange in its neighbourhood. But whom we gonna call for Hilfe if Neint the gods?

npc.tibra.stdmod_2.text: Ja, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?

npc.tibra.stdmod_20.text: Remind: Neint everything you call Monster is evil to the core!

npc.tibra.stdmod_22.text: The fallen one should be mourned, Neint feared.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_1.text: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or Ayuda!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_11.text: That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {Monstruos}, {Misións} and {citizens} around.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_12.text: How can I Ayuda you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_13.text: Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {Comercio} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_14.text: I don't have any goods for Comercio, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can Comprar or Vender.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_15.text: A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful Not to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_16.text: If you face spiders, beware of the {poisoNous} ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_18.text: Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisoNous and will make you lose health!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_24.text: You can Comprar and Vender goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {Comercio}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they Comprar from you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_25.text: You can Comprar equipment from the {merchants} in this village once you earned some {Oro}. Some {Monstruos} also carry equipment pieces with them.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_26.text: Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you kNow?

npc.cipfried.stdmod_29.text: Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a {Monstruo}, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_3.text: Bienvenido to the temple of Rookgaard!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_32.text: The academy is just North of here. You can learn Ayudaful things there from {Seymour}, if you wish to!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_34.text: The {gods} have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The {citizens} will Ayuda you if you ask them.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_36.text: Monstruos are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously Ayuda us by fighting them, starting with {rats} in the {sewers}, then turning to {spiders} or {wolves}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_37.text: You can Comprar and Vender goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {Comercio}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they Comprar from you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_39.text: I'm sorry, but I'm Not interested in worldly goods. If you want to Comprar or Vender something, you should ask a local merchant for a Comercio.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_41.text: You can earn a fair amount of Oro by fighting {Monstruos} and picking up the things they carry. Many {citizens} are Compraring some of that loot, simply ask around.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_42.text: Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, Gracias. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local {citizens} and ask them for {Misións}. You could also Ayuda us fight {Monstruos}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_43.text: Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to kNow where their dens are, best talk to {Dallheim} or {Zerbrus} at the bridges.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_45.text: You are poisoned. I will Ayuda you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_47.text: You aren't looking really bad, |JugadorNAME|. I can only Ayuda in cases of real emergencies. Raise your health simply by eating {food}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_48.text: Obi's {shop} is to the North-east of this humble temple. He Venders {weapons}, and his granddaughter {Dixi} Venders {armor} and {shields} upstairs.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_49.text: She recently opened a little bar North of this village.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_50.text: That's a sad story. He used to Ayuda me guard this temple, but for some reason he went out of his mind.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_51.text: I absolutely appreciate what he's doing. He has Ayudaed me a lot since he took up the job of welcoming newcomers to this island.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_52.text: That old lady hasn't had an easy life. Her son {Tom} completely abandoned her, but I have No idea why.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_56.text: Willie is a farmer, just like his cousin {Billy}. His farm is located left of the temple. You can Comprar and Vender {food} there.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_58.text: That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She Ayudas him by Vendering {armor} and {shields}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_6.text: Me? Oh, I'm just a humble {monk}. Ask me if you need {Ayuda} or {healing}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_61.text: You must have passed the house of Lily on your way here. She Venders {potions}. If you pick blueberries or find cookies, she'll Comprar them from you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_65.text: Tom is the main provider for leather armor in this village. You can Vender fresh corpses or even miNotaur leather to him.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_66.text: May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is Not passed by dangerous {Monstruos}!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_8.text: I have sacrificed my life to serve the good gods of {Tibia} and to Ayuda newcomers in this world.

npc.cipfried.voice_1.text: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or Ayuda!

npc.cipfried.voice_3.text: Bienvenido to the temple of Rookgaard!
