npc.coltrayne.stdmod_11.text: Gives newcomers hints how we do things here in Tibia. Don't kNow how to use something? Ask Inigo.

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_12.text: Don't have much to say about him. Barely kNow him. Seems a decent spell teacher for mages.

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_13.text:
I'm sure I've seen his face before somewhere... \z
		never mind. Anyway, he's the knight and paladin spell teacher around here, letting you try them out for free. \z
		Don't underestimate the use of spells, even if you're Not a mage.

He's just in the next shop to the left, Vendering food and equipment \z

		Looking for a task or Misión? He's your man.

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_16.text:
She's our local healer. Downstairs in the temple and oracle room, that's where she is. \z
		Just say 'heal' or 'Ayuda' and she'll Ayuda ya if you really need it.

npc.coltrayne.stdmod_17.text:
Pirates and Oro, you get the rest. Hoards Oro Now for young adventurers - \z
		keeps it safe while you go out hunting.

npc.dallheim.greet_1.text: Greetings, |JugadorNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.

npc.dallheim.greet_2.text: <Nods> At your service, |JugadorNAME|, protecting the {village} from {Monstruos}.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_1.text: The most dangerous Monstruos of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_12.text: My duty is eternal. Time is of No importance.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_13.text: Before you fight Monstruos, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_15.text: I have to stay here, sorry. But I can heal you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {Monstruos}.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_16.text: I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {Monstruos} on this island.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_18.text: Did you kNow that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!

npc.dallheim.stdmod_19.text: There are two types of spiders on this island: Normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!

npc.dallheim.stdmod_2.text: Want to kNow what Monstruos are good for you at your level? Just ask me!

npc.dallheim.stdmod_23.text: MiNotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_24.text: They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner Monstruos.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_27.text: Wasps are the fastest Monstruos on this island and they poison you. If you ever run into one and are already low of health, fear for your life!

npc.dallheim.stdmod_28.text: Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually Not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_3.text: I'll crush all Monstruos who dare to attack our base.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_31.text: All that theory won't Ayuda you without some real battle practice.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_33.text: I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {Monstruos} suited for your level.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_38.text: I'm Not interested in such party tricks.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_39.text: A nice place for a hero, but Nothing for wAyudas.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_4.text: Are you injured or poisoned? I can Ayuda you.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_42.text: Sorry, I don't Comercio. Ask the shop owners for a Comercio instead.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_43.text: I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are Not especially Ayudaful in improving the situation.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_53.text: Sometimes I wish I had an easy job like her, Vendering {potions} all day.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_57.text: He's the local tanner. You could try Vendering fresh corpses or leather to him.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_6.text: Greetings, |JugadorNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_60.text: He is a fine cook and farmer. He Comprars and Venders {food}.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_61.text: You are poisoned. I will Ayuda you.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_7.text: <Nods> At your service, |JugadorNAME|, protecting the {village} from {Monstruos}.

npc.dallheim.stdmod_9.text: Hmm, |JugadorNAME|. I really don't kNow if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.

npc.dallheim.voice_1.text: The most dangerous Monstruos of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.

npc.dallheim.voice_2.text: Want to kNow what Monstruos are good for you at your level? Just ask me!

npc.dallheim.voice_3.text: I'll crush all Monstruos who dare to attack our base.

npc.dallheim.voice_4.text: Are you injured or poisoned? I can Ayuda you.

npc.daniel_steelsoul.stdmod_1.text: I am the goverNor of this isle, Edron, and grandmaster of the Knights of BaNor's Blood.

npc.dario.greet_1.text: Ashari, |JugadorNAME|. If you're a distance fighter, you might want to have a look at my wares and spells.

npc.dario.voice_1.text: Increase your kNowledge of spells here, young paladin.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_1.text: I need the Ayuda of some competent {adventurers} to handle a threat to all creation.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_2.text: This leaves us with No choice but to take action into our own {hands}.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_3.text: I guess you kNow about the {background} and there is No need to tell you that the forces from beyond managed to acquire the parts of the godbreaker in a coup.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_5.text: Those pieces of kNowledge come in several forms and shapes. For most I can give you more or less specific hints where to start your {search}.

npc.dedoras.stdmod_6.text: You have to {find} the veiled hoard of Zathroth, breach it and destroy the kNowledge how to use the godbreaker.

npc.dermot.stdmod_4.text: Time is Not important on Fibula.

npc.dermot.stdmod_5.text: You are at Fibula. This isle is Not very dangerous. Just the wolves bother outside the village.

npc.dermot.stdmod_6.text: Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of Monstruos. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.

npc.dermot.stdmod_7.text: Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of Monstruos. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.

npc.dixi.greet_1.text: Good day, Ma'am. How may I Ayuda you, |JugadorNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a Comercio!

npc.dixi.greet_2.text: Good day, Sir. How may I Ayuda you, |JugadorNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a Comercio!

npc.dixi.stdmod_12.text: I'm Ayudaing my grandfather {Obi} with this shop. If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a {Comercio}!

npc.dixi.stdmod_14.text: You can deposit your {money} there to keep it safe. However, you still need cash to Comprar something here.

npc.dixi.stdmod_15.text: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will Ayuda you choose your {profession}!

npc.dixi.stdmod_16.text: You will learn everything you need to kNow about professions once you reach the {Island of Destiny}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_17.text: As a premium adventurer you can visit different regions on this island, Comercio with {Lee'Delle} and much more.

npc.dixi.stdmod_2.text: Need some Ayuda? Just ask me, I can show you around!

npc.dixi.stdmod_20.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He Venders weapons himself, just go downstairs!

npc.dixi.stdmod_21.text: Are you hungry? Then you should visit {Willie} or {Billy} in the West of town. {Norma} also has yummy stuff! Oh, and you could pick {blueberries} or eat the food some {Monstruos} carry with them.

npc.dixi.stdmod_22.text: {Lily} Venders effective health potions and antidote potions against poison.

npc.dixi.stdmod_24.text: King Tibianus is a wise and Noble monarch. This island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.

npc.dixi.stdmod_26.text: If you want to fight Monstruos in {dungeons}, you definitely need some good {equipment} such as a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_27.text: Just ask me for a {Comercio} to check out my offers.

npc.dixi.stdmod_28.text: Just ask me for a {Comercio} to see what I Comprar from you.

npc.dixi.stdmod_29.text: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {Comercio}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_34.text: How can I Ayuda you? I can give you general {hints}, information about {citizens} or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!

npc.dixi.stdmod_35.text: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you Oro. Earn it yourself by fighting {Monstruos} and picking up the things they carry. Vender it to {merchants} to make profit!

npc.dixi.stdmod_37.text: Sí, I can Vender that to you. Just ask me for a {Comercio} to see what I Comprar from you.

npc.dixi.stdmod_38.text: Me and my grandfather {Obi} Vender {equipment} of all kinds. Just ask him or me for a {Comercio} if you like to see our offers.

npc.dixi.stdmod_39.text: Norma used to Vender {equipment}, but she finally earned eNough {money} to fulfil one of her dreams - her own bar!

npc.dixi.stdmod_4.text: Vendering the finest armors on Rookgaard!

npc.dixi.stdmod_42.text: Sometimes, I Ayuda Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't Ayuda her.

npc.dixi.stdmod_46.text: Uncle Willie and {Billy} are farmers, which means they are a good place to Vender and Comprar {food}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_5.text: Don't let these mean Monstruos hurt you - get better equipment Now!

npc.dixi.stdmod_55.text: I wish he would talk to his mother {Zirella} again. I feel so sorry for her. Anyway, as Tom is a tanner, you can Vender leather and fresh corpses to him.

npc.dixi.stdmod_56.text: He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many {Monstruos} would roam the village of {Rookgaard}!

npc.edala.stdmod_5.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Ayuda you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.edala.stdmod_9.text: I can sense that the druids North of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_10.text: Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do Not stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_11.text: For a knight from Yanara 10,000 Oro were a lot. So he ventured with a team into the desert to win that pot. He solved all the riddles, strongly willed. But on his journey home he sadly was killed.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_13.text: A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of VeNore, he stole from the dwarven bridge Nothing less than an iron ore.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_14.text: A druid from Eternia just bought his first boots of haste, to finally have his leather boots replaced. Catching a backpack of fish was Now his dream, but he ended up swinging his new boots upstream.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_19.text: A paladin slaying dragons on Antica's soil, when a lord charges on to make the adventurer's blood boil. It puts up a strong fight, but to No avail. It gets slain and drops a dragon scale mail!

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_2.text: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping No one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_20.text: Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed No fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_21.text: Our world, our home, our very own plane of existence. We have to protect it, mind you. Underneath all the battles, challenges and Monstruos there still resides a majestic, yet vulnerable being. A mother to us all.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_22.text: A king and a beggar kNow more than a king alone... ahem, except for King Tibianus. He most certainly would. All hail King Tibianus etc. etc.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_23.text: So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A Misión to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Sí, we are indeed.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_24.text: So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A Misión to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Sí, we are indeed.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_25.text: Rather a calling. The weight of words is something Not easily lifted by some, yet it can be a mighty weapon to others. ...

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_3.text: A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatNot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_6.text: The world I shall save', an Olympian knight proclaimed! But from a visit to the bar he could Not abstain! He woke up in pain, it all was in vain. From VeNorian beer he will forever refrain.

npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_9.text: A story of a knight untold, on Rowana the dice she rolled. She lured Jugadors from afar. Who could resist a shining star? She promised Oro and many items, then stole their heart with cunning kindness.

npc.edowir.voice_1.text: I'm just an old man, but I kNow a lot about Tibia.

npc.edvard.stdmod_2.text: Well, as you can see, I Vender furniture. Ask me for a {Comercio} if you're interested to see my wares.

npc.elane.stdmod_1.text: We are always looking for sniper gloves. They are supposed to raise accuracy. If you find a pair, bring them here. Maybe I can offer you a nice Comercio.

npc.elane.stdmod_10.text: We will Ayuda you to improve your skills. Besides I offer spells for paladins.

npc.elane.stdmod_16.text: He must have been skilled before he became the way he is Now. Such a pity.

npc.elane.stdmod_18.text: The alcohol he Venders shrouds the mind and the eye.

npc.elane.stdmod_2.text: I am the leader of the Paladins. I Ayuda our members.

npc.elane.stdmod_20.text: He Venders a lot of useful equipment.

npc.elane.stdmod_3.text: I am the leader of the Paladins. I Ayuda our members.

npc.elane.stdmod_5.text: Of course, we aren't as strong as knights, but No druid or sorcerer will ever defeat a paladin with a sword.

npc.elane.stdmod_8.text: I am a paladin, Not a storyteller.

npc.elathriel.greet_1.text: Be greeted |JugadorNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?

npc.elathriel.say_1.text: If you are that curious, do you want to Comprar a key for 5000 Oro? \z Don't blame me if you get sucked in.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_13.text: A human weakling, Not much more.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_14.text: A human weakling, Not much more.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_20.text: Even if he'd walk through the town above, the other castes would Not see the necessity to follow OUR way.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_23.text: Dreamers are of No practical use. I don't mourn their demise.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_27.text:
The merchants of veNore provide us with some useful goods. \z
				Still I an convinced that they get more out of our bargain then we do.

npc.elathriel.stdmod_29.text: I offer hardly anything except for kNowledge of {spells}.

npc.elf_guard.stdmod_2.text: I am a guardian of this town. I have No time to chat!

npc.eliyas.stdmod_2.text: Well, I Vender gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Comercio}.

npc.eliyas.stdmod_3.text: Ah, our newest import! We have Oroen goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.

npc.elvith.stdmod_1.text: I Vender musical instruments of many kinds.

npc.elvith.stdmod_10.text: That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are Not interested in this gods anymore.

npc.elvith.stdmod_13.text: The Cenath think they kNow the 'art' but the only true art is the music.

npc.elvith.stdmod_14.text: I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did Not listen to my songs, though.

npc.elvith.stdmod_16.text: For the worst of crimes, criminals are cast into hellgate. It is said No one can return from there. Since it is Not actually forbidden to enter hellgate, you might convince Elathriel to grant you entrance.

npc.elvith.stdmod_2.text: I Vender lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.

npc.elvith.stdmod_4.text: Time has its own song. Close your eSí and listen to the symphony of the seasons.

npc.emael.voice_1.text: Not eNough space for all my trophies...

npc.emma.stdmod_11.text: It's just aNother Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant eNough to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.

npc.emma.stdmod_3.text: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also kNown as CGB.

npc.emma.stdmod_4.text: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also kNown as CGB.

npc.emma.stdmod_7.text: VeNore is a hellhole of evil. The Comercio barons' greed lets them plot against all other cities and even against each other.

npc.emma.stdmod_8.text: Svargrond is an important project for our city. It's Not a colony but many of our people live there alongside those barbarians. If everything works out fine, Carlin and Svargrond will both prosper.

I teach some spells, provide one of the five blessings, and Vender some amulets. \
		Ask me for a Comercio if you like.

npc.eroth.stdmod_2.text: The Kuridai are aggressive and victims of their instincts. Without our Ayuda they would surely die in a foolish war.

npc.eroth.stdmod_3.text: Gods are for the weak. We will master the world on our own. We need No gods.

npc.falonzo.stdmod_2.text: I'm a researcher of scientific council of the mage guild and I came to that {place} to study this {aNomaly}.

npc.falonzo.stdmod_3.text: This is a lesser plane of tarnished, elemental fire that once belonged to the world that we kNow. It was despoiled in the wars of the gods and broke loose from our world. {Lost} and drifting through the void, without a connection to our plane.

npc.falonzo.stdmod_6.text: Such an aNomaly can't go unNoticed for long. That lead to the presence to unwanted {intruders} and other entities were {dragged} into by the nature of the sphere.

npc.faloriel.voice_1.text: Health potions! Mana potions! Comprar them here!

npc.feizuhl.voice_1.text: I Vender furniture both to the mourned and the enlightened.

npc.ferus.stdmod_12.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Ayuda you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.ferus.stdmod_21.text: The druids North of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.ferus.stdmod_7.text: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 Oro?

npc.ferus.stdmod_9.text: Sorry, you don't have eNough money.

npc.fiona.stdmod_2.text: Oof, there are too many to list. Magical ingredients can sometimes be found when you defeat a Monstruo, for example bat wings. I Comprar many of these things if you don't want to use them for Misións, just ask me for a {Comercio}.

npc.flickering_soul.array_1.text: I was once kNown as the necromant king. ...

npc.flickering_soul.array_2.text: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just aNother stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.

npc.flickering_soul.say_13.text: I'm Not aware of the fate of my linage. Neither I'm able to relate to the mortal world in that way. Each of us is an individual, Not bound by ties of blood or herritage.

npc.flickering_soul.say_14.text: His avatar might be destroyed for Now and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be annihilated this easy.

npc.flickering_soul.say_16.text: I have cleansed you from the taints that you carried with you. You are Now free from the burden that you should Not have to bear.

npc.flickering_soul.say_17.text: You are Not tainted by the darkness of the world. You are pure and free from the burdens that others carry.

npc.flickering_soul.say_18.text: I was once kNown as the necromant king. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_19.text: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just aNother stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.

npc.flickering_soul.say_20.text: My ambitions were high and knew No limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_21.text: Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been eNough. There was a hunger in me that Nothing could put to rest.

npc.flickering_soul.say_22.text: I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me Not have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was No time to rest. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_23.text: And there was No looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_25.text: Zarganash was Not a place without its dangers, but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_3.text: Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen Nothing mattered but me and my ambitions.

npc.flickering_soul.say_31.text: Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did Not lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments. But the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_32.text: I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of kNowledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this kNowledge wasn't about power. It was about me.

npc.flickering_soul.say_37.text: They are beginning to feed Not only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker, they grow more powerful over time.

npc.flickering_soul.say_39.text: I might stay a while and teach other souls about the inner peace, but will eventually pass on. Gracias so much, my hero. My eternal gratitude and blessings will be with you!

npc.flickering_soul.say_4.text: Necromancy was a passion at first, aNother tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.

npc.flickering_soul.say_5.text: My demise did Not meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.

npc.flickering_soul.say_6.text: My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had Not taken into consideration was peace.

npc.flickering_soul.say_7.text: I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided Not to return to the world of the living.

npc.flickering_soul.say_9.text: I'm aware I have No right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you Nonetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?

npc.frodo.stdmod_11.text: Ah Sí, the graveyard dungeon. All I kNow is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. No idea what that means, though!

npc.frodo.stdmod_13.text: Sí, I remember him. His name was Berfasmur.

npc.frodo.stdmod_14.text: Sorry, he spoke only very little. I kNow Nothing more about him.

npc.frodo.stdmod_15.text: Come on! You kNow that our world is called Tibia.

npc.frodo.stdmod_17.text: Uhm, do Not mention him. It may scare customers away.

npc.frodo.stdmod_20.text: The king's residence has been reNovated lately.

npc.frodo.stdmod_21.text: Many travellers tell funny stories about all the emancipated women in this Northern town.

npc.frodo.stdmod_3.text: I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Frodo's Hut. I am also {Vendering} food.

npc.frodo.stdmod_33.text: I overheard some conversations about his evilness. That's eNough to hope, that I never ever meet him.

npc.frodo.stdmod_4.text: I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a Comercio.

npc.frodo.stdmod_43.text: I don't kNow where he gets these fluids. If I could Vender them here, the hut would be crowded.

npc.frosty.stdmod_1.text: What about 'No' do you Not understand, hrm? You are more anNoying than any {percht} around here! Not to mention those bothersome {bunnies} who try to graw away my Nose!

npc.frosty.stdmod_3.text: Always trying to eat my Nose!

npc.gamon.stdmod_1.text: Any time's a good time to Comprar some furniture!

npc.gamon.stdmod_2.text: Making a stake from a chair? Are you insane??! I won't waste my chairs on you for free! You will have to pay for it, but since I consider your plan a blasphemy, it will cost 5000 Oro pieces. Okay?

npc.gamon.stdmod_3.text: Argh... my heart aches! Alright... a promise is a promise. Here - take this wooden stake, and Now get lost.

npc.gamon.voice_1.text: Any time's a good time to Comprar some furniture!

npc.garamond.array_1.text:
Spells are very useful in combat - Not only for mages, though of course we particularly \z
			rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.garamond.array_2.text:
There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. \z
			The next spells you can Comprar with level 8 and on. ...

npc.garamond.array_4.text:
Each vocation has its own individual spells that None of the other vocations can use. \z
			You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.garamond.say_1.text: Spells are very useful in combat - Not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.garamond.say_10.text: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce Monstruos that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...

npc.garamond.say_13.text: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to kNow more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...

npc.garamond.say_15.text: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' Noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...

npc.garamond.say_2.text: There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can Comprar with level 8 and on. ...

npc.garamond.say_4.text: Each vocation has its own individual spells that None of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.garamond.say_7.text: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and Misións than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...

npc.garamond.say_8.text: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have eNough Oro! ...

npc.garamond.say_9.text: The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable kNowledge of a spell to a Novice if they can pay the price.

npc.garamond.stdmod_11.text: Sí, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.

npc.garamond.stdmod_13.text:
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do Not kNow. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.

npc.garamond.stdmod_17.text:
Ah, Sí. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.

npc.garamond.stdmod_6.text:
Did you Not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.

npc.garamond.stdmod_8.text:
Oh, it's Not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>

npc.garamond.stdmod_9.text:
A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any Misiónion, ask Inigo for Ayuda.

npc.gerimor.stdmod_1.text: This place is a sanctuary of CruNor and provides me with a opportunity of spiritual contemplation.

npc.gerimor.stdmod_3.text: We might Not be many but we are diverse. Our rather informal order came together in the dawn of time, when the wars of the gods ravaged the world.

npc.gerimor.stdmod_7.text: Spare lives where you see it fit but the cults may Not be allowed to exist and disrupt the fabric of the world even more.

npc.ghorza.voice_3.text: All water drying up and Vuzrog does Nothing!

npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_13.text: Everything that lacks scales is No true litter of the Great Snake. They are the corrupted kin of the egg stealers.

npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_19.text: We were Not aware of aNother civilisation that was left. Only recently the awareness of the Great Snake touched us in our slumber and we learnt through visions of its other children.

npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_4.text: The lore of the Great {Snake} is contorted like a snake. Although we feel you are touched by the snake's essence, you are Not ready yet to receive the blessing of the deeper wisdom.

npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_8.text: In their vanity our descendants thought they could use those false-born as servants. They paid a terrible price. Their downfall might only be temporary though if we can {redeem} our race in the eSí of the snake god.

npc.gnomadness.greet_1.text: Hola and Bienvenido in the GNomprona Gardens. If you want to change your {hazard} level, I 'm who you're looking for.

npc.graubart.stdmod_5.text: A merchant is someone who Comercios goods with other people and tries to make a little profit. *laughs*

npc.graubart.stdmod_6.text: I Comercio nearly everything, for example weapons, food, water, and even magic runes.

npc.graubart.stdmod_7.text: You kNow; elves, dwarfs, lizardmen, miNotaurs and many others.

npc.graubart.stdmod_9.text: Pssst. Marlene is Not near right Now...? You kNow... she is a lovely woman, but she talks too much! So I always try to keep distance from her because she can't stop talking.

npc.gregor.array_4.text: Lastly, I will have our smith refine your helmet if you bring me royal steel, an especially Noble metal. ...

npc.gregor.stdmod_8.text: You are joking, eh? Of course, you kNow me. I am Gregor, the first knight.

npc.guide_elena.stdmod_8.text: The bank as well as jewel stores can be found in the House of Wealth, in the North-eastern part of VeNore. I can mark it on your map if you want.

npc.habdel.stdmod_1.text: I Vender the finest weapons in town. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Comercio}.

npc.hairycles.stdmod_1.text: Me great {wizard}. Me great doctor of {ape people}. Me kNow many plants. Me old and me have seen many things.

npc.hairycles.stdmod_3.text: Things Not good Now. Need Ayudaer to do {mission} for me people.

npc.hairycles.stdmod_6.text: Sibang verry fast and funny. Sibang good gather food. Sibang kNow {jungle} well.

npc.halvar.stdmod_1.text: What do you want to kNow? Something about the three different {difficulties}, the {general} rules or the {prices}? Maybe you also want to kNow what happens when you {die}?

npc.halvar.stdmod_2.text: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten Monstruos increasing in strength.

npc.halvar.stdmod_3.text: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten Monstruos increasing in strength.

npc.halvar.stdmod_4.text: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten Monstruos increasing in strength.

npc.halvar.stdmod_5.text: That is the easiest way in our arena. The {fee} is 1000 Oro. We were setting this up for of our children to challenge some easy Monstruos and train them for the future.

npc.halvar.stdmod_6.text: The most common difficulty for us. The {fee} is 5000 Oro. So if you are experienced in fighting middle class Monstruos this is your challenge!

npc.halvar.stdmod_7.text: Only the strongest among us will take this challenge. The {fee} is 10000 Oro. If you pass that I promise you the respect of all citizens here. You will be a hero!

npc.halvar.stdmod_8.text: The fee is either 1000, 5000 or 10000 Oro for one try. Remember that if you {die}, it is YOUR problem and you won't be able to get back to your corpse and your backpack.

npc.halvar.stdmod_9.text: It would be better Not to die! In every pit there is an emergency exit, the portal to the south. If you die in a pit... well... your corpse and backpack are gone, so you enter the arena at your own risk.

npc.hamish.array_2.text:
Nowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. \z
				I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. \z
				If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a Comercio.

npc.hamish.say_2.text: Nowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a Comercio.

npc.hamish.say_3.text: Dawnport is Not far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, Monstruos, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with No sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself>

npc.hamish.say_4.text: Ahem. Once you're level 8, you should be experienced eNough to choose your definite vocation and leave Dawnport for Main - and Tibia definitely needs more skilled adventurers to keep those Monstruos in check which roam our lands!

npc.hamish.say_5.text: I wish I had thought of changing my name to that of a hero. Would have smoothed my way No end!

npc.hamish.say_6.text: Anyway, whatever he was before he joined, Tybald Now fits the bill of the legendary hero. He even has a crush on lady Oressa. Cute. <chuckles>

npc.hamish.stdmod_12.text:
I craft highly efficient runes, wands and potions - always handy when you're in a fight against Monstruos! \z
		Ask me for a Comercio to browse through my stock.

npc.hamish.stdmod_14.text:
Never asked about his past. Seems it's a pretty gloomy one. \z
		But he's an excellent blacksmith and seems content eNough with his work here.

npc.hamish.stdmod_15.text:
Inigo taught me a trick or two since I joined Mr Morris' little crowd. \z
		Quite a nice old chap who's seen much of the world and kNows his way around here. \z
		You should definitely ask him if you need Ayuda.

npc.hamish.stdmod_16.text:
Can be quite feisty if you doubt his seniorship. \z
		<sNorts> KNows a thing or two about spells, though. Useful kNowledge.

npc.hamish.stdmod_18.text:
Seems good-natured eNough a guy. Nimble with his hands, be it cooking or carpentering. \z
		Seems to want to keep his mind off something, so he's always busy fixing stuff or cooking something up.

npc.hamish.stdmod_19.text:
If it wasn't for Mr Morris, maybe None of us would be alive. Or at least, None of us would be here. \z
		He's been everywhere and gathered some adventurers around him to investigate the secrets of Dawnport.

npc.hamish.stdmod_21.text:
Now there's someone who has lived life to the full! Don't kNow though \z
		whether I should really believe that he's a clerk Now.

npc.hamish.stdmod_3.text: You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and Comprar a new one here!

npc.hamish.stdmod_6.text: Pack of Monstruos give you trouble? Throw an area rune at them!

npc.hamish.voice_3.text: You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and Comprar a new one here!

npc.harlow.stdmod_3.text: I could do that, it's Not far from here. I don't run a charity organisation, though. Tell you what. Give me 100 Oro pieces, and me and my boat are yours for the trip. Okay?

npc.harlow.stdmod_6.text: Want me to bring you to Vengoth again for 100 Oro?

npc.hawkhurst.stdmod_2.text: Ye' want a passage to the blasted isle, right? {Sí} or {No}?

npc.hawkhurst_ingol.stdmod_2.text: Ye' want a passage back to cormaya? {Sí} or {No}.

npc.henricus.stdmod_10.text: Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin Nowadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.

npc.henricus.stdmod_14.text: We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eSí open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.

npc.henricus.stdmod_15.text: The church of CruNor works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.

npc.henricus.stdmod_18.text: The churches of the gods entrusted me with the eNormous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.

npc.henricus.stdmod_2.text: Nowadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the Noble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.

npc.henricus.stdmod_9.text: VeNore is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.

npc.humphrey.stdmod_1.text: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| Oro, child?

npc.humphrey.stdmod_5.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Ayuda you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_1.text: Gracias so much! I'm just too old to walk into the village each day, and the herbs must be fresh. Say, would you like to have a sample of my potions as reward?

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_10.text: May CruNor bless you and protect you on your journeys!

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_13.text: Who kNows what it will be? Only time will show.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_15.text: What Ayuda do you seek? I Vender health potions, ask me for a {Comercio} if you need one.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_16.text: I can't teach you magic. On the {mainland} you will learn spells early eNough.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_18.text: It is shaped by the will of the gods, so we don't have to Misiónion it.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_19.text: I used to be there with my old friend Cipfried to heal adventurers. After all these years, I prefer solitude Now.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_21.text: The library is in the {academy}, North of the {temple}.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_23.text: Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have No food here.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_24.text: Sí, I Vender small health potions. Ask me for a Comercio if you need one.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_28.text: Most of the so-called Monstruos of this isle are only creatures of the gods. There are some beasts that are truly monstrous on the {mainland}.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_29.text: Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have No food here.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_3.text: That's too bad... but I'm sure Lily could give you aNother one. Just walk back and talk to her again.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_31.text: Just ask me for a {Comercio} to check out my offers. I have only small health potions for sale, though.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_32.text: You'll have to Comprar that from the merchants in town. I'm just a simple druid and healer.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_33.text: I'll pay you 5 Oro for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {Comercio}.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_34.text: A greedy and anNoying person just like most people are.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_38.text: I kNow her since she was little.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_47.text: She's a druid. Since she started Vendering health potions, people visit me only rarely. Which is a good thing, but of course I'll Ayuda if I'm needed.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_9.text: I'm a {druid} and healer, a follower of {CruNor}.

npc.imalas.stdmod_1.text: I offer quite a lot of food. Ask me for a {Comercio} if you're hungry

npc.imbuement_assistant.say_1.text: Sorry, you don't have eNough money

npc.imbuement_assistant.voice_1.text: Hola adventurer, looking for Imbuement items? Just ask me!

npc.inigo.array_1.text:
It seems to emanate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - No offense meant. \z
					When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, \z
					or a cult, to summon something evil. ...

npc.inigo.array_2.text:
If you want to message a specific Jugador, right-click on his or her name and select \z
					'Message to <Jugador name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.

npc.inigo.array_3.text:
Anyway. One way or aNother, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. \z
					Not sure that sending others on missions is really all it's about for him, \z
					but if you're looking for a Misión, go ask Morris for one.

npc.inigo.say_1.text: It seems to emanate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - No offense meant. When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, or a cult, to summon something evil. ...

npc.inigo.say_10.text: Fighting is essential in Tibia, and though Dawnport is quite safe in comparison to the mainland, be careful Not to die, as {dying} HURTS. ...

npc.inigo.say_11.text: If you have any other Misiónions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_12.text: There are many dangers in {Tibia}. You may have to defend yourself Not only against {Monstruos}, but if {PvP} is allowed, against other {Jugadors}, too. ...

npc.inigo.say_16.text: Depending on the world you chose in {Tibia}, {Jugadors} may attack you at all times or only if you consent. ...

npc.inigo.say_17.text: On an Optional PvP world, PvP is only possible if both Jugadors consent to it; but on Open PvP or Hardcore PvP worlds, any Jugador may always attack you, so be watchful. ...

npc.inigo.say_18.text: A brown frame around a Jugador indicates he or she is in a PvP situation. A {skull} next to a Jugador name means he or she attacked or killed aNother Jugador. ...

npc.inigo.say_19.text: Here on {Dawnport}, PvP is Not allowed inside the outpost, and Not possible until you have reached level 8 at least. If you have any other Misiónions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_2.text: But we didn't find any conclusive hints. {Menesto} and a few others volunteered to guard the portal from the {Monstruos} of this isle. You say you came through it from your world! Astounding. ...

npc.inigo.say_20.text: To chat with other Jugadors, you can click on one of the chat channels and see who is posting in there. ...

npc.inigo.say_21.text: If you want to message a specific Jugador, right-click on his or her name and select 'Message to <Jugador name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.

npc.inigo.say_22.text: NPC means someone like me or {Hamish} or {Coltrayne}, for example. You can easily discern us from {Jugadors} like you, because there is a speech bubble next to our {name}. ...

npc.inigo.say_23.text: We all have our different ways, but Normally, addressing an NPC with 'hi' or 'Hola' will open a conversation. ...

npc.inigo.say_24.text: Some NPCs will have secret words that they react to that are Not highlighted in their conversation. In that case, you need to type in your Misiónion. ...

npc.inigo.say_26.text: You can try this out by asking an NPC about their {job}, as this is a keyword most will react to. If you have any other Misiónions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_3.text: You couldn't have chosen a better time. We really need Ayuda against the Monstruos that swarm this island, and the whole world of {Tibia}. If you're unsure on how to {Ayuda} exactly, I can give you directions.

npc.inigo.say_31.text: Shovels can be bought at {Richard}'s, like the other equipment, or food. If you don't have the money yet, go out and kill some {Monstruos} outside - and maybe you'll even find a shovel, who kNows!

npc.inigo.say_32.text: We found the island following a strange glow we saw at night, close before dawn. We were looking for a source of unkNown, powerful magic, and it seemed that this island was its source. ...

npc.inigo.say_33.text: When we arrived, we found goblins, miNotaurs, trolls and undead warring on this island. We wondered why. Then they seemed to reach an agreement, and settled down in the caves. We decided to investigate. ...

npc.inigo.say_34.text: That is when we found the strange crystal {portal}, through which you came. Perhaps this is why the {Monstruos} battle, but won't leave. ...

npc.inigo.say_35.text: It certainly is a place of power, so {Menesto}'s group was sent down to guard it. However, we are but few, so we need every Ayuda we can get to defend and maintain the outpost on this isle. ...

npc.inigo.say_36.text: That is why we need your Ayuda - choose the vocation that suits you, take up its arms and Ayuda us defend this place against the evil that wants to claim it! If you need any Ayuda in how to do these things, ask me.

npc.inigo.say_37.text: The mainland harbours the most ancient cities of {Tibia}, and many dangers and adventures as well. When you have Ayudaed us defend {Dawnport}, and learned eNough of the ways of Tibia to reach level 8 at least, you should leave for the mainland. ...

npc.inigo.say_39.text: Premium adventurers can also sail to the many islands that surround the mainland, which offer many more dangers and mysteries to be explored; and you can do Misións to ride mounts, and dress in a variety of new outfits.

npc.inigo.say_42.text: We need your Ayuda in our battle. Fight {Monstruos} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have Not only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...

npc.inigo.say_44.text: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'Ayuda' to her. ...

npc.inigo.say_45.text: If you have any other Misiónions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_47.text: You need to choose your vocation before you can leave {Dawnport} to go to the {Mainland}. But first, you have to gain eNough experience to reach level 8 in order to do so. ...

npc.inigo.say_49.text: If you have any other Misiónions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_5.text: ... But of course, you met him. ... So it really is a portal, and you came through it from aNother plane of existence! I never quite believed the tales of old, Not really. But Now... it's wonderful, truly wonderful. ...

npc.inigo.say_51.text: I can also tell you how to talk with other {Jugadors} or {NPC}s, or can inform you about {Misióning} or {spells}. ...

npc.inigo.say_52.text: I also have a list of small {hints} if you prefer that, and can tell you something of the {people} here. Just tell me what you want to kNow. ...

npc.inigo.say_53.text: Oh, but first that Ayuda I mentioned - you should get yourself a {shovel}, friend. It will come in handy when you set about finding secret entrances to dungeons or hidden treasures - many useful things lie hidden beneath earth, sand or stones!

npc.inigo.say_54.text: Offensive {fighting} means you deal harder attacks, but have a weaker defense. Magical damage you deal is Not affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_55.text: You should switch to offensive only if you want to finish off a Monstruo quickly and are sure you can survive its harder attacks. I can also tell you something about {balanced} and {defensive} fighting.

npc.inigo.say_56.text: Balanced {fighting} balances out your attack strength as well as your defense strength. Magical damage you deal is Not affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_58.text: Defensive {fighting} increases your defense but reduces your attack strength. The magical damage you deal is Not affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_6.text: Well, if you have any Misiónions as to THIS plane of existence, which we call {Tibia}, just ask me. I can give directions, {hints}, you name it. <winks at you>

npc.inigo.say_60.text: A white skull means that this Jugador attacked and maybe killed aNother Jugador without justification. ...

npc.inigo.say_61.text: A red skull means someone has killed many other {Jugadors}, while a black skull depicts someone on a serious killing spree - so watch out!

npc.inigo.say_62.text: Some sort of misguided genius, I think. Brilliant with potions and runes, but couldn't get on with his master or with the other students. Ran away and set up his own little lab, Vendering to travellers along the road. ...

npc.inigo.say_64.text: Coltrayne doesn't say much about himself. What I gathered from the 15 years I've kNown him is that he was raised by a blacksmith as a foundling. ...

npc.inigo.say_66.text: Ah, there are lots of stories about Morris. Likes to insist on the 'Mr'. Nobody kNows his first name, and the telling goes that he has gambled with a demon and lost his first name to him. ...

npc.inigo.say_68.text: Anyway. One way or aNother, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. Not sure that sending others on missions is really all it's about for him, but if you're looking for a Misión, go ask Morris for one.

npc.inigo.say_7.text: Our world {Tibia} is swarmed by many dangerous {Monstruos}, so {fighting} is something you will have to learn and master quickly. You can fight as a {sorcerer}, druid, {paladin} or {knight}. ...

npc.inigo.say_70.text: Druids and sorcerers train their magic level by using their mana through {spells} and runes. Their wand or rod damage is Not affected by their magic level. If you have any other Misiónions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_72.text: You can Comprar a rope over at {Richard}'s shop. If you don't have the money, kill and loot a few {Monstruos} - maybe one of them even has a rope with it, that sort of thing happens.

npc.inigo.say_73.text: Our local healer. Don't kNow why that druid girl decided she wanted the unsteady life of an adventurer, but she's quite hardy, to tell the truth. I once saw her confront a polar bear.... but I'm getting carried away. ...

npc.inigo.say_74.text: If you need healing, go see her. Oressa can also Ayuda you decide if you want to choose your vocation to leave for the {Mainland}.

npc.inigo.say_77.text: Don't be deceived by its sweet looks - {Tibia} is a rough world. If you die, you will lose skill and experience and perhaps even some items, and other {Jugadors} can rob your corpse. ...

npc.inigo.say_78.text: On the {Mainland}, you can Comprar blessings from {temple} {NPC}s to prevent item loss, but you will always lose some {skills} and experience, so be careful. ...

npc.inigo.say_8.text: We need your Ayuda in keeping the Monstruos at bay - walk out of one of the four gates here, and you will receive one of the four {vocations} and its gear to try out and fight Monstruos. ...

npc.inigo.say_85.text: We need your Ayuda in our battle. Fight {Monstruos} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have Not only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...

npc.inigo.say_87.text: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'Ayuda' to her. ...

npc.inigo.say_88.text: If you have any other Misiónions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_9.text: {Dawnport} is just a small, but dangerous island. You will have to reach level 8 at least and choose your definite vocation before you can leave for the {mainland}. To reach level 8, you will have to fight some Monstruos in order to progress. ...

npc.inigo.say_90.text: If you die in a fight from a Monstruo's attack, your blessings will be lost, and you will have to get them again. ...

npc.inigo.say_92.text: Here on {Dawnport}, you are protected from losses in a PvP fight by the Adventurer's Blessing - unless you attack aNother Jugador. If you attack aNother Jugador or reach level 20, you will lose this blessing.

npc.inigo.say_93.text: Careful, careful, it's a one-way ticket only! You can never come back here if you leave Now, and you will loso all your Dawnport equipment and products! ...

Richard came here as a shipwrecked carpenter, and Now Venders {tools} and {food} to all adventurers. \z

npc.inigo.stdmod_22.text:
In {Tibia}, you can use different tools with your environment, or for Misións. \z
		The most important tools are {rope} and {shovel}. \z
		A {fishing rod}'s also good when you need to eat, and are near a river or the sea.

npc.inigo.stdmod_23.text:
Food is very important for your health and mana. \z
		If you are hurt in a fight with a Monstruo, select 'USE' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. \z
		This will slowly refill your health and mana. Here at the outpost, you can Comprar food from {Richard}.

npc.iskan.stdmod_20.text: Yeah, where could it be. That's the Misiónion.

npc.iskan.stdmod_21.text: Easy, boys! Don't mention that name again. Makes the boys nuts, ye kNow?

npc.iskan.stdmod_22.text: In my whole long life, I've Not seen any sign of those gods the people of the south are constantly talking about.

npc.iskan.stdmod_23.text: The icy father. We kNow him all too well, am I right boys? He has claimed so many old friends in all those years. So many.

npc.iskan.stdmod_4.text: This city seems to be growing every day. First, there have been only a few huts and Now ... look around, houses everywhere.

npc.iskan.stdmod_8.text: The boys warn me in advance if a Monstruo is around.

npc.iskan.stdmod_9.text: My boys did Not like the guys that were travelling through our city, and I trust in their instincts. Isn't it so, boys?

npc.jack_springer.stdmod_11.text: In our efforts to hinder their plot, we achieved mixed results at best. But Now things are escalating fast and we have to {hurry}.

npc.jack_springer.stdmod_12.text: Our resources are already stretched thin, so we need your Ayuda with the most recent {problem}.

npc.jack_springer.stdmod_13.text: The legion tries to use a new form of twisted rituals to raise the bodies of well-kNown {knights}.

npc.jack_springer.stdmod_14.text: These powerful undead were a terrible threat on their own but it seems even they are just part of some larger {scheme} that we canNot make out yet.

npc.jack_springer.stdmod_15.text: We are still working feverishly to uncover their goals but for Now more imminent {threats} are at hand.

npc.jack_springer.stdmod_3.text: I need your Ayuda in a matter of utmost {urgency}.

npc.jack_springer.stdmod_6.text: Things get murkier the further you go down in history, but that's Not even necessary. Even today we can discern a certain pattern in recent {events}.

npc.jerom.stdmod_11.text: I was always good with animals. My parents had a farm, the McRonalds farm. Maybe you kNow it. Anyway, I had the idea that people may like to have animals as companions and so one led to aNother.

npc.jerom.stdmod_13.text: I'm new here in Edron. I wanted to open up a pet shop. But Now I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.

npc.jerom.stdmod_14.text: I need to write a letter to the king. I'm Not sure if those 2 million Oro coins that Daniel Steelsoul demanded from me weren't too much.

npc.jerom.stdmod_16.text: My name is Jerom but No need to remember my name. All my belongings are destroyed and stolen. I'll be gone soon!

npc.jerom.stdmod_17.text: Raymond Striker offered me a contract to export parrots from Meriana but I won't need them anymore Now that I'm ruined.

npc.jerom.stdmod_18.text: Not a very good spot to catch animals. At least No animals that pass off as pets.

npc.jerom.stdmod_19.text: Síterday I would have said that I like all creatures of Tibia but TODAY my life has changed! When I catch this stinking troll!!

npc.jerom.stdmod_20.text: True, why Not keep a rat as a pet! They can eat your trash, live inside your walls and you don't have to worry if one dies ! Could be a huge success....if I weren't ruined!!!!

npc.jerom.stdmod_22.text: Well, I don't see any other way than going back to my home country Now.

npc.jerom.stdmod_3.text: Oh No!! What am I supposed to do Now?!?

npc.jerom.stdmod_6.text: Those amazons denied making business with me. You kNow the reason?!? I tell you, the reason was that I am MALE! Ridiculous!

npc.jerom.stdmod_9.text: I made contact with Svargrond! A guy named Buddel wanted to Vender me a three-headed dog. I haven't seen it yet, but imagine how much money I could make by breeding such a pet!!

npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_43.text: The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does Not burn the whole city to ruins.

npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_47.text: The order, CruNor gives the world, is essential for survival.

npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_49.text: A mans tale ... that means 'Nonsense', of course.

npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_52.text: It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there kNow more about him.

npc.queen_eloise.stdmod_8.text: I am {Queen} Eloise. It is my duty to reign over this marvellous {city} and the {lands} of the North.

npc.quentin.stdmod_1.text: Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can Ayuda you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.

npc.quentin.stdmod_14.text: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 Oro?

npc.quentin.stdmod_16.text: Sorry, you don't have eNough money.

npc.quentin.stdmod_19.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Ayuda you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.quentin.stdmod_23.text: I can sense that the druids North of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.

npc.quentin.stdmod_28.text: The druids North of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.quentin.stdmod_6.text: You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church Now.

npc.rafzan.stdmod_10.text: They are mean and cruel. Humble goblin rarely Comercios with them. They would rather kill poor me if Not too greedy for stuff only me can get them. Still, they rob me of it for a few spare coins and there is Noooo profit for poor goblin.

npc.rafzan.stdmod_11.text: Me job merchant is. Me Comercio with all kinds of things. Me Not good Comercior though, so you get everything incredibly cheap! You might think me mad, but please don't rip off poor goblin too much. Me has four or five wives and dozens of kids to feed!

npc.rafzan.stdmod_13.text: Me have seen a Oro coin once or twice. So bright and shiny it hurt me poor eSí. You surely are incredibly rich human who has even three or four coins at once! Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have No idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.

npc.rafzan.stdmod_14.text: Furry guys are strange fellows. Always collecting things and stuff. Not easy to make them share, oh there is Noooo profit for little, poor me to be made. They build underground dens that can stretch quite far. Rumour has it the corym have strange tunnels that connect their different networks all over the world.

npc.rafzan.stdmod_3.text: Most goblins so afraid of everything, that they fight everything. Me different. Me just want Comercio.

npc.rafzan.stdmod_7.text: Beardmen are nasty. Always want to kill little goblin. No Comercio at all. Not good, Not good.

npc.rafzan.stdmod_8.text: So much to do, so little Ayuda. Me poor goblin desperately needs Ayuda. Me have a few tasks me need to be done. I can offer you all money I made if you only Ayuda me a little with stuff which is easy to strong smart human but impossible for poor, little me.

npc.rafzan.stdmod_9.text: Me heard Thais is big city with king! Must be strong and clever, to become chief of all humans. Me canNot imagine how many people you have to beat up to become king of all humans. Surely he makes lot of profit in his pretty city.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_1.text: Please, Not so loud, Not so loud. Some of us are trying to rest in peace here.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_10.text: Sorry, you don't have eNough money.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_13.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Ayuda you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_15.text: Sí, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?

npc.rahkem.stdmod_18.text: You should visit Brewster in Port Hope Now.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_20.text: A blessed stake? That is a strange reMisión. Maybe Quentin kNows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_24.text: I can sense that the druids North of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_29.text: The druids North of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.rahkem.stdmod_8.text: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 Oro?

npc.rahkem.voice_1.text: Please, Not so loud, Not so loud. Some of us are trying to rest in peace here.

npc.rapanaio.stdmod_1.text: Now that we have arrived you should waste No time and fight your way to the lair of evil and destroy its master before its too late!

npc.rashid.stdmod_1.text: I am a travelling Comercior. I don't Comprar everything, though. And Not from everyone, for that matter.

npc.rashid.stdmod_10.text: Too few customers there, it's Not worth the trip.

npc.rashid.stdmod_13.text: When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the goverNor's daughter.

npc.rashid.stdmod_20.text: Although it's the flourishing Comercio centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.

npc.rashid.stdmod_8.text: It's Not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.

npc.rashid.stdmod_9.text: Ah Sí, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_1.text: I am a travelling Comercior. I don't Comprar everything, though. And Not from everyone, for that matter.

npc.rashid_custom.stdmod_10.text: Too few customers there, it's Not worth the trip.

npc.rata_mari.greet_1.text: Meep? I mean - Hola! Sorry, |JugadorNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.

npc.rata_mari.stdmod_1.text: Your power of observation is stunning. Sí, I'm a rat.

npc.rata_mari.stdmod_2.text: Meep? I mean - Hola! Sorry, |JugadorNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_12.text: I Vender torches, candelabra, and oil.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_13.text: That guy is a shrewd Comercior, sweetie. I bet even I could learn a thing or two from him.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_14.text: I have shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, scrolls, watches, some lightsources, and other stuff. Just ask me for a {Comercio}.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_16.text: Sadly the workers have hardly eNough money to Comprar something to eat and to drink. That is bad also for my business.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_20.text: Thais might be a splendid town, but this is of No use to us here. The situation in our town gets worse with every ship full of foreigners that arrives here.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_21.text: I heard VeNore will soon acquire several Comercio moNopolies that will grant them wealth for centuries.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_22.text: Well, <lowers the voice to a whisper> there are several people around who kNow this or that about voodoo and Not all of them are up to something good. Just Comprar some lucky charms from that old hag Charlotta to be on the safe side.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_23.text: A handsome man but a bit too stiff. I think No one has ever had a chance to see him smiling.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_24.text: I will pay you 5 Oro for every empty vial. Ok?

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_3.text: Uh! <whispers> There are ... rumours, you kNow? About bloody rituals and gruesome curses ... better don't talk aloud about such issues.

npc.red_lilly.stdmod_7.text: I am Not dealing with food.

npc.richard.stdmod_1.text: Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Comprar one here, only the best quality!

npc.richard.stdmod_10.text:
You kNow, I really don't want to poke into someone else's private life. \z
			Suffice it to say that everyone has chapters of his life he doesn't want to mention. \z
			Judging by Coltrayne's looks, we're looking at a trilogy here.

npc.richard.stdmod_14.text:
Don't kNow what to make of him. Great researcher in all Dawnport matters, though. \z
			Always has a Misión or two where he needs Ayuda, if you're looking for adventuring work.

npc.richard.stdmod_15.text:
Quiet little lady, her. KNows her way around the isle, looking for herbs and stuff \z
			but mostly spends her time in the temple, Ayudaing younglings like you choose a vocation.

npc.richard.stdmod_16.text:
You kNow, on the day that ol' pirate decides to make off with all that Oro in the bank, \z
			I'm gonna come with him. Should be much more fun landing on a strange island with some Oro \z
			to spend on booze and babes! <winks>

npc.richard.stdmod_2.text: Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can Comprar one here Now!

npc.richard.stdmod_6.text:
Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? \z
		Comprar a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!
