npc.riddler.stdmod_2.text: His name is None of your business

npc.riddler.stdmod_4.text: I am kNown as the riddler. That is all you need to kNow.

npc.robson.voice_2.text: Just great. Getting stranded on a remote underground isle was Not that bad but Now I'm becoming a tourist attraction!

npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_1.text: Have you Noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to anNounce: I'm a Comercior

npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_3.text: I can Ayuda you Comprar trading stuff with you. Good for me, good for you. It's a win-win!

npc.rock_in_a_hard_place.stdmod_4.text: Have you Noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to anNounce: I'm a Comercior

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_12.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Ayuda you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_16.text: I can sense that the druids North of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_21.text: The druids North of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_7.text: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 Oro?

npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_9.text: Sorry, you don't have eNough money.

npc.romella.stdmod_3.text: I have many weapons to offer. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Comercio}.

npc.romella.stdmod_4.text: I Vender and Comprar weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Comercio}.

npc.romella.stdmod_8.text: Make sure to Comprar some extra weapons before facing that one.

npc.sam.stdmod_1.text: Hola there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!

npc.sam.voice_1.text: Hola there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!

npc.sandra.stdmod_3.text: I Vender potions and fluids. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Comercio}.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_2.text: What have I become? What is slime if it's Not for everyone?

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_3.text: Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... Not?

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_4.text: I AM THE... I mean... I am - what is a mage, if he is Not {mad}? If he isn't... raging? I am... I am just sane. A sane mage.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_5.text: I am Not mad... I- Sí, that's the whole problem, isn't it? What's going on, what's happening to me? I don't even kNow anymore.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_6.text: Sí, well... I'm taking a break. It will take some time. I don't kNow how long I just... I want to get away from all this for some time, that's it.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_7.text: Slime is my mission. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right Now at least.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_8.text: Slime is my mission. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right Now at least.

npc.sane_mage.stdmod_9.text: You want to Ayuda me? Ayuda me? You? Who... who are you anyway? Ah nevermind.

npc.sane_mage.voice_2.text: What have I become? What is slime if it's Not for everyone?

npc.sane_mage.voice_3.text: Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... Not?

npc.santiago.voice_1.text: Evil little beasts... I hope someone Ayudas me fight them.

npc.santiago.voice_3.text: Hey! You over there, could you Ayuda me with a little Misión? Just say 'hi' or 'Hola' to talk to me!

npc.santiago.voice_4.text: Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'Hola' or 'hi'!

npc.ser_tybald.array_1.text:
Spells are very useful in combat - Not only for mages, though of course we particularly \z
			rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_2.text:
There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. \z
			The next spells you can Comprar with level 8 and on. ...

npc.ser_tybald.array_4.text:
Each vocation has its own individual spells that None of the other vocations can use. \z
			You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_1.text: Spells are very useful in combat - Not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_10.text: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce Monstruos that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_13.text: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to kNow more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_15.text: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' Noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_2.text: There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can Comprar with level 8 and on. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_4.text: Each vocation has its own individual spells that None of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_7.text: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and Misións than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_8.text: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have eNough Oro! ...

npc.ser_tybald.say_9.text: The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable kNowledge of a spell to a Novice if they can pay the price.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_11.text: Sí, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_13.text:
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do Not kNow. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_17.text:
Ah, Sí. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_6.text:
Did you Not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_8.text:
Oh, it's Not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>

npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_9.text:
A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any Misiónion, ask Inigo for Ayuda.

npc.seymour.farewell_1.text: Good bye, |JugadorNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!

npc.seymour.greet_1.text: Hola, |JugadorNAME|. Bienvenido to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?

npc.seymour.stdmod_1.text: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your Misiónions!

npc.seymour.stdmod_100.text: Dixi Venders and Comprars {armors}, {shields}, {helmets} and {legs}. You can find her shop south of the academy, just go up the stairs in {Obi}'s shop.

npc.seymour.stdmod_101.text: A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He Venders small health {potions} just like {Lily}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_102.text: Lee'Delle's shop is in the western part of town, on the {premium} side. She Venders everything cheaper.

npc.seymour.stdmod_103.text: In the southern part of town, Lily Venders {potions} which might come in handy once you are deep in a dungeon and need {health}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_105.text: Sí, Paulie is very important. He is the local {bank} clerk.

npc.seymour.stdmod_107.text: Tom the tanner Comprars fresh {corpses}, miNotaur leather and paws. Always good to make some {money} if you can carry the corpses there fast eNough.

npc.seymour.stdmod_108.text: He's the guard on the North {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {Monstruo} locations. Just ask him about Monstruos!

npc.seymour.stdmod_109.text: He's the guard on the west {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {Monstruo} locations. Just ask him about Monstruos!

npc.seymour.stdmod_18.text: Gracias! Here is a helmet that will serve you well.

npc.seymour.stdmod_20.text: Well, I would like to send our king a little present but I do Not have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.

npc.seymour.stdmod_21.text: You are pretty inexperienced. I think killing rats is a suitable challenge for you. For each fresh {dead rat} I will give you two shiny coins of Oro.

npc.seymour.stdmod_27.text: At least you kNow how to address a man of my importance.

npc.seymour.stdmod_3.text: Feeling lost? Ask me for Ayuda!

npc.seymour.stdmod_30.text: In a bank you can deposit your earned Oro coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.

npc.seymour.stdmod_31.text: Sí, depositing your money will keep it safe, so it is a good idea to store it in the bank. Of course, you can always withdraw it again.

npc.seymour.stdmod_33.text: Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any Non-Jugador character and I will tell you something about him or her.

npc.seymour.stdmod_34.text: Merchants Comprar and Vender goods. Just ask them for a {Comercio} to see what they offer or Comprar from you.

npc.seymour.stdmod_35.text: Trolls are quite nasty Monstruos which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!

npc.seymour.stdmod_36.text: The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {Monstruos} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.

npc.seymour.stdmod_4.text: Gain some kNowledge in the academy!

npc.seymour.stdmod_42.text: We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the North-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_44.text: The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually Notices emergencies by himself.

npc.seymour.stdmod_47.text: You gain experience when fighting {Monstruos}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.

npc.seymour.stdmod_48.text: Good Monstruos to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.

npc.seymour.stdmod_5.text: Hola, |JugadorNAME|. Bienvenido to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?

npc.seymour.stdmod_53.text: Make money by killing {Monstruos} and picking up their {loot}. You can Vender many of the things they carry.

npc.seymour.stdmod_54.text: Once a Monstruo is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other items which you can Vender to {merchants}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_55.text: You can even Vender some corpses! For example, you can Vender fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also Comprars other dead creatures, just ask him for a {Comercio}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_56.text: You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Comprar one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_57.text: A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large eNough to enter.

npc.seymour.stdmod_58.text: You should Not descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {Monstruos}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_59.text: A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can Comprar them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_60.text: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {Misión} if you're interested.

npc.seymour.stdmod_61.text: The starter armor, a coat, does Not protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {Comercio}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_62.text: The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and Comprar a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {Comercio}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_63.text: A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either Comprar it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong eNough, {loot} them from {trolls}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_64.text: I fear you have to Comprar your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.

npc.seymour.stdmod_65.text: Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either Comprar them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong eNough, {loot} them from {trolls}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_66.text: Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can Comprar them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong eNough, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_67.text: Many Monstruos, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also Comprar food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.

npc.seymour.stdmod_70.text: Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can Comprar them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.

npc.seymour.stdmod_71.text: Some Monstruos poison you. To heal poison, use an antidote potion on yourself. Comprar them at {Lily}'s store.

npc.seymour.stdmod_73.text: The island is separated into a {premium} side and a Non-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other Jugadors.

npc.seymour.stdmod_76.text: There is a bridge to the North and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.

npc.seymour.stdmod_78.text: You have to fight {Monstruos} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {health}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_79.text: The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right Now though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_8.text: Only Nonsense on your mind, eh?

npc.seymour.stdmod_80.text: Once you gained eNough experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {health} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.

npc.seymour.stdmod_81.text: The farms are west of here. You can Comprar and Vender {food} there which you need to regain {health}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_82.text: To attack a rat, simply click on it in your battle list. Make sure that you have proper {equipment}, though! Also, I give you 2 Oro coins for each {dead rat}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_11.text: That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {Monstros}, {Missãos} and {citizens} around.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_12.text: How can I Ajuda you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_13.text: Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {Comércio} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_14.text: I don't have any goods for Comércio, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can Comprar or Vender.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_15.text: A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful Nãot to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_16.text: If you face spiders, beware of the {poisoNãous} ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_18.text: Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisoNãous and will make you lose health!

npc.cipfried.stdmod_24.text: You can Comprar and Vender goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {Comércio}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they Comprar from you.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_25.text: You can Comprar equipment from the {merchants} in this village once you earned some {Ouro}. Some {Monstros} also carry equipment pieces with them.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_26.text: Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you kNãow?

npc.cipfried.stdmod_29.text: Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a {Monstro}, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_36.text: Monstros are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously Ajuda us by fighting them, starting with {rats} in the {sewers}, then turning to {spiders} or {wolves}.

npc.cipfried.stdmod_37.text: You can Comprar and Vender goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {Comércio}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they Comprar from you.

npc.flickering_soul.say_13.text: I'm Nãot aware of the fate of my linage. Neither I'm able to relate to the mortal world in that way. Each of us is an individual, Nãot bound by ties of blood or herritage.

npc.flickering_soul.say_14.text: His avatar might be destroyed for Nãow and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be annihilated this easy.

npc.flickering_soul.say_16.text: I have cleansed you from the taints that you carried with you. You are Nãow free from the burden that you should Nãot have to bear.

npc.flickering_soul.say_17.text: You are Nãot tainted by the darkness of the world. You are pure and free from the burdens that others carry.

npc.flickering_soul.say_18.text: I was once kNãown as the necromant king. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_19.text: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just aNãother stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.

npc.flickering_soul.say_20.text: My ambitions were high and knew Não limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_21.text: Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been eNãough. There was a hunger in me that Nãothing could put to rest.

npc.flickering_soul.say_22.text: I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me Nãot have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was Não time to rest. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_23.text: And there was Não looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_24.text: Nãow I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.

npc.flickering_soul.say_25.text: Zarganash was Nãot a place without its dangers, but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_3.text: Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen Nãothing mattered but me and my ambitions.

npc.flickering_soul.say_31.text: Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did Nãot lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments. But the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_32.text: I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of kNãowledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this kNãowledge wasn't about power. It was about me.

npc.flickering_soul.say_37.text: They are beginning to feed Nãot only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker, they grow more powerful over time.

npc.flickering_soul.say_38.text: You did it! For the first time I can feel free from the pull of my past. Nãow I'm free at last. ...

npc.flickering_soul.say_39.text: I might stay a while and teach other souls about the inner peace, but will eventually pass on. Obrigado so much, my hero. My eternal gratitude and blessings will be with you!

npc.flickering_soul.say_4.text: Necromancy was a passion at first, aNãother tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.

npc.flickering_soul.say_5.text: My demise did Nãot meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.

npc.flickering_soul.say_6.text: My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had Nãot taken into consideration was peace.

npc.flickering_soul.say_7.text: I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided Nãot to return to the world of the living.

npc.flickering_soul.say_9.text: I'm aware I have Não right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you Nãonetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?

npc.halvar.stdmod_2.text: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten Monstros increasing in strength.

npc.halvar.stdmod_6.text: The most common difficulty for us. The {fee} is 5000 Ouro. So if you are experienced in fighting middle class Monstros this is your challenge!

npc.halvar.stdmod_7.text: Only the strongest among us will take this challenge. The {fee} is 10000 Ouro. If you pass that I promise you the respect of all citizens here. You will be a hero!

npc.hamish.say_2.text: Nãowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a Comércio.

npc.hamish.say_3.text: Dawnport is Nãot far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, Monstros, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with Não sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself>

npc.hamish.say_4.text: Ahem. Once you're level 8, you should be experienced eNãough to choose your definite vocation and leave Dawnport for Main - and Tibia definitely needs more skilled adventurers to keep those Monstros in check which roam our lands!

npc.hamish.say_5.text: I wish I had thought of changing my name to that of a hero. Would have smoothed my way Não end!

npc.hamish.say_6.text: Anyway, whatever he was before he joined, Tybald Nãow fits the bill of the legendary hero. He even has a crush on lady Oressa. Cute. <chuckles>

npc.hamish.stdmod_12.text:
I craft highly efficient runes, wands and potions - always handy when you're in a fight against Monstros! \z
		Ask me for a Comércio to browse through my stock.

npc.hamish.stdmod_14.text:
Never asked about his past. Seems it's a pretty gloomy one. \z
		But he's an excellent blacksmith and seems content eNãough with his work here.

npc.hamish.stdmod_15.text:
Inigo taught me a trick or two since I joined Mr Morris' little crowd. \z
		Quite a nice old chap who's seen much of the world and kNãows his way around here. \z

Can be quite feisty if you doubt his seniorship. \z
		<sNãorts> KNãows a thing or two about spells, though. Useful kNãowledge.

npc.hamish.stdmod_18.text:
Seems good-natured eNãough a guy. Nimble with his hands, be it cooking or carpentering. \z
		Seems to want to keep his mind off something, so he's always busy fixing stuff or cooking something up.

npc.hamish.stdmod_19.text:
If it wasn't for Mr Morris, maybe Nãone of us would be alive. Or at least, Nãone of us would be here. \z
		He's been everywhere and gathered some adventurers around him to investigate the secrets of Dawnport.

npc.hamish.stdmod_21.text:
Nãow there's someone who has lived life to the full! Don't kNãow though \z
		whether I should really believe that he's a clerk Nãow.

npc.hamish.stdmod_3.text: You levelled up but your wand is old? Come and Comprar a new one here!

npc.hawkhurst.stdmod_2.text: Ye' want a passage to the blasted isle, right? {Sim} or {Não}?

npc.henricus.stdmod_10.text: Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin Nãowadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.

npc.henricus.stdmod_14.text: We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eSim open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.

npc.henricus.stdmod_15.text: The church of CruNãor works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.

npc.henricus.stdmod_18.text: The churches of the gods entrusted me with the eNãormous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.

npc.henricus.stdmod_2.text: Nãowadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the Nãoble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.

npc.henricus.stdmod_9.text: VeNãore is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.

npc.humphrey.stdmod_1.text: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| Ouro, child?

npc.humphrey.stdmod_5.text: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Ajuda you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_1.text: Obrigado so much! I'm just too old to walk into the village each day, and the herbs must be fresh. Say, would you like to have a sample of my potions as reward?

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_10.text: May CruNãor bless you and protect you on your journeys!

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_13.text: Who kNãows what it will be? Only time will show.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_15.text: What Ajuda do you seek? I Vender health potions, ask me for a {Comércio} if you need one.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_16.text: I can't teach you magic. On the {mainland} you will learn spells early eNãough.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_18.text: It is shaped by the will of the gods, so we don't have to Missãoion it.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_19.text: I used to be there with my old friend Cipfried to heal adventurers. After all these years, I prefer solitude Nãow.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_21.text: The library is in the {academy}, Nãorth of the {temple}.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_23.text: Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have Não food here.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_24.text: Sim, I Vender small health potions. Ask me for a Comércio if you need one.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_28.text: Most of the so-called Monstros of this isle are only creatures of the gods. There are some beasts that are truly monstrous on the {mainland}.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_29.text: Are you hungry? I'm sorry, I have Não food here.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_3.text: That's too bad... but I'm sure Lily could give you aNãother one. Just walk back and talk to her again.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_31.text: Just ask me for a {Comércio} to check out my offers. I have only small health potions for sale, though.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_32.text: You'll have to Comprar that from the merchants in town. I'm just a simple druid and healer.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_33.text: I'll pay you 5 Ouro for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {Comércio}.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_34.text: A greedy and anNãoying person just like most people are.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_35.text: Nãow she has completely gotten out of her mind.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_38.text: I kNãow her since she was little.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_47.text: She's a druid. Since she started Vendering health potions, people visit me only rarely. Which is a good thing, but of course I'll Ajuda if I'm needed.

npc.hyacinth.stdmod_9.text: I'm a {druid} and healer, a follower of {CruNãor}.

npc.imalas.stdmod_1.text: I offer quite a lot of food. Ask me for a {Comércio} if you're hungry

npc.imbuement_assistant.say_1.text: Sorry, you don't have eNãough money

npc.inigo.say_1.text: It seems to emanate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - Não offense meant. When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, or a cult, to summon something evil. ...

npc.inigo.say_10.text: Fighting is essential in Tibia, and though Dawnport is quite safe in comparison to the mainland, be careful Nãot to die, as {dying} HURTS. ...

npc.inigo.say_11.text: If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_12.text: There are many dangers in {Tibia}. You may have to defend yourself Nãot only against {Monstros}, but if {PvP} is allowed, against other {Jogadors}, too. ...

npc.inigo.say_16.text: Depending on the world you chose in {Tibia}, {Jogadors} may attack you at all times or only if you consent. ...

npc.inigo.say_17.text: On an Optional PvP world, PvP is only possible if both Jogadors consent to it; but on Open PvP or Hardcore PvP worlds, any Jogador may always attack you, so be watchful. ...

npc.inigo.say_18.text: A brown frame around a Jogador indicates he or she is in a PvP situation. A {skull} next to a Jogador name means he or she attacked or killed aNãother Jogador. ...

npc.inigo.say_19.text: Here on {Dawnport}, PvP is Nãot allowed inside the outpost, and Nãot possible until you have reached level 8 at least. If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_2.text: But we didn't find any conclusive hints. {Menesto} and a few others volunteered to guard the portal from the {Monstros} of this isle. You say you came through it from your world! Astounding. ...

npc.inigo.say_20.text: To chat with other Jogadors, you can click on one of the chat channels and see who is posting in there. ...

npc.inigo.say_21.text: If you want to message a specific Jogador, right-click on his or her name and select 'Message to <Jogador name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.

npc.inigo.say_22.text: NPC means someone like me or {Hamish} or {Coltrayne}, for example. You can easily discern us from {Jogadors} like you, because there is a speech bubble next to our {name}. ...

npc.inigo.say_23.text: We all have our different ways, but Nãormally, addressing an NPC with 'hi' or 'Olá' will open a conversation. ...

npc.inigo.say_24.text: Some NPCs will have secret words that they react to that are Nãot highlighted in their conversation. In that case, you need to type in your Missãoion. ...

npc.inigo.say_26.text: You can try this out by asking an NPC about their {job}, as this is a keyword most will react to. If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_3.text: You couldn't have chosen a better time. We really need Ajuda against the Monstros that swarm this island, and the whole world of {Tibia}. If you're unsure on how to {Ajuda} exactly, I can give you directions.

npc.inigo.say_31.text: Shovels can be bought at {Richard}'s, like the other equipment, or food. If you don't have the money yet, go out and kill some {Monstros} outside - and maybe you'll even find a shovel, who kNãows!

npc.inigo.say_32.text: We found the island following a strange glow we saw at night, close before dawn. We were looking for a source of unkNãown, powerful magic, and it seemed that this island was its source. ...

npc.inigo.say_33.text: When we arrived, we found goblins, miNãotaurs, trolls and undead warring on this island. We wondered why. Then they seemed to reach an agreement, and settled down in the caves. We decided to investigate. ...

npc.inigo.say_34.text: That is when we found the strange crystal {portal}, through which you came. Perhaps this is why the {Monstros} battle, but won't leave. ...

npc.inigo.say_35.text: It certainly is a place of power, so {Menesto}'s group was sent down to guard it. However, we are but few, so we need every Ajuda we can get to defend and maintain the outpost on this isle. ...

npc.inigo.say_36.text: That is why we need your Ajuda - choose the vocation that suits you, take up its arms and Ajuda us defend this place against the evil that wants to claim it! If you need any Ajuda in how to do these things, ask me.

npc.inigo.say_37.text: The mainland harbours the most ancient cities of {Tibia}, and many dangers and adventures as well. When you have Ajudaed us defend {Dawnport}, and learned eNãough of the ways of Tibia to reach level 8 at least, you should leave for the mainland. ...

npc.inigo.say_39.text: Premium adventurers can also sail to the many islands that surround the mainland, which offer many more dangers and mysteries to be explored; and you can do Missãos to ride mounts, and dress in a variety of new outfits.

npc.inigo.say_42.text: We need your Ajuda in our battle. Fight {Monstros} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have Nãot only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...

npc.inigo.say_44.text: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'Ajuda' to her. ...

npc.inigo.say_45.text: If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_47.text: You need to choose your vocation before you can leave {Dawnport} to go to the {Mainland}. But first, you have to gain eNãough experience to reach level 8 in order to do so. ...

npc.inigo.say_49.text: If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.

npc.inigo.say_5.text: ... But of course, you met him. ... So it really is a portal, and you came through it from aNãother plane of existence! I never quite believed the tales of old, Nãot really. But Nãow... it's wonderful, truly wonderful. ...

npc.inigo.say_51.text: I can also tell you how to talk with other {Jogadors} or {NPC}s, or can inform you about {Missãoing} or {spells}. ...

npc.inigo.say_52.text: I also have a list of small {hints} if you prefer that, and can tell you something of the {people} here. Just tell me what you want to kNãow. ...

npc.inigo.say_53.text: Oh, but first that Ajuda I mentioned - you should get yourself a {shovel}, friend. It will come in handy when you set about finding secret entrances to dungeons or hidden treasures - many useful things lie hidden beneath earth, sand or stones!

npc.inigo.say_54.text: Offensive {fighting} means you deal harder attacks, but have a weaker defense. Magical damage you deal is Nãot affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_55.text: You should switch to offensive only if you want to finish off a Monstro quickly and are sure you can survive its harder attacks. I can also tell you something about {balanced} and {defensive} fighting.

npc.inigo.say_56.text: Balanced {fighting} balances out your attack strength as well as your defense strength. Magical damage you deal is Nãot affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_58.text: Defensive {fighting} increases your defense but reduces your attack strength. The magical damage you deal is Nãot affected by this. ...

npc.inigo.say_6.text: Well, if you have any Missãoions as to THIS plane of existence, which we call {Tibia}, just ask me. I can give directions, {hints}, you name it. <winks at you>

npc.inigo.say_60.text: A white skull means that this Jogador attacked and maybe killed aNãother Jogador without justification. ...

npc.inigo.say_61.text: A red skull means someone has killed many other {Jogadors}, while a black skull depicts someone on a serious killing spree - so watch out!

npc.inigo.say_62.text: Some sort of misguided genius, I think. Brilliant with potions and runes, but couldn't get on with his master or with the other students. Ran away and set up his own little lab, Vendering to travellers along the road. ...

npc.inigo.say_64.text: Coltrayne doesn't say much about himself. What I gathered from the 15 years I've kNãown him is that he was raised by a blacksmith as a foundling. ...

npc.inigo.say_66.text: Ah, there are lots of stories about Morris. Likes to insist on the 'Mr'. Nãobody kNãows his first name, and the telling goes that he has gambled with a demon and lost his first name to him. ...

npc.inigo.say_68.text: Anyway. One way or aNãother, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. Nãot sure that sending others on missions is really all it's about for him, but if you're looking for a Missão, go ask Morris for one.

npc.inigo.say_69.text: Nãot your level, but your skill with your weapon determines how much damage you make. With a distance weapon like a bow, you {train} your distance {fighting} skill, with a sword your sword fighting, etc. ...

npc.inigo.say_7.text: Our world {Tibia} is swarmed by many dangerous {Monstros}, so {fighting} is something you will have to learn and master quickly. You can fight as a {sorcerer}, druid, {paladin} or {knight}. ...

npc.inigo.say_70.text: Druids and sorcerers train their magic level by using their mana through {spells} and runes. Their wand or rod damage is Nãot affected by their magic level. If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.

npc.seymour.stdmod_35.text: Trolls are quite nasty Monstros which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!

npc.seymour.stdmod_36.text: The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {Monstros} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.

npc.seymour.stdmod_4.text: Gain some kNãowledge in the academy!

npc.seymour.stdmod_57.text: A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large eNãough to enter.

npc.seymour.stdmod_58.text: You should Nãot descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {Monstros}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_59.text: A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can Comprar them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_60.text: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {Missão} if you're interested.

npc.seymour.stdmod_61.text: The starter armor, a coat, does Nãot protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {Comércio}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_62.text: The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and Comprar a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {Comércio}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_64.text: I fear you have to Comprar your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.

npc.seymour.stdmod_65.text: Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either Comprar them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong eNãough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
